name: 101 Real Estate
description: 101 Real Estate is a Surinamese real estate agency offering property sales, rentals and property management services across Paramaribo and surrounding districts. A trusted partner for residential and commercial property transactions.

name: 101 Suites
description: 101 Suites is a small business hotel on Keizerstraat in the centre of Paramaribo, within walking distance of the Waterkant, the shops on Domineestraat and the historic inner city.

name: 19 Trading
description: 19 Trading is a building materials supplier at Bomaweg 35 in Paramaribo, selling tiles, sanitary ware and plumbing supplies for building and renovation projects. The shop is open Monday to Saturday from 07:30 to 17:00 and can be reached on +597 350-733.

name: 4R Gym Academia
description: 4R Gym Academia is a fitness and wellness centre in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering training courses and gym facilities. Located at Verlengde Gemenelandsweg #127.

name: 4x4 Rental
description: 4x4 Rental in Zorg en Hoop offers construction tools and equipment for hire, including vibration plates, breakers, leaf blowers, drills and stone cutters. Open Monday to Saturday for contractors and DIY projects.

name: N.V. 82 TRADING
description: N.V. 82 Trading is a roofing sheet specialist selling roofing, wall cladding, timber and other building materials, with its main location at J.D. Gomperstraat 82 in Paramaribo and branches across Suriname.

name: A+ Bouwmaterialen
description: A+ Bouwmaterialen is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering plumbing supplies, electrical supplies and construction. Located at Verlengde Gemenelandsweg 122A.

name: A La John
description: A La John is a restaurant in Paramaribo run by Chef John, serving dishes that combine traditional Surinamese flavours with modern cooking techniques. The kitchen uses locally sourced ingredients across a menu covering both everyday meals and special occasion dining. One of Paramaribo's more creative independent restaurants.

name: AaBéCé Graphics & Signs
description: AaBéCé Graphics & Signs is a long-established graphics and signage company on W.L. Lothlaan in Paramaribo, offering print and signage solutions, screen printing, embroidery and promotional products.

name: Aakhri Safar Mijnzorg
description: Aakhri Safar Mijn Zorg is a funeral company on Commissaris Weytingweg in Paramaribo that has provided funeral insurance and funeral services since 2007.

name: Aaras Cafe
description: Aaras Café is a café and eatery in Paramaribo serving light meals, fresh coffee and local snacks. Relaxed atmosphere, friendly service. A neighbourhood gathering spot.

name: Aatrios Management & Consultancy BV
description: Aatrios Management & Consultancy BV is a management consultancy at J.A. Pengelstraat 129 in Paramaribo, with a team drawn from government, public relations and finance.

name: ABC Opleiding & Training Suriname N.V.
description: ABC Opleiding & Training offers nationally and internationally recognised courses and training programmes from its location at Louiselaan 115 in Paramaribo, and also has a branch in Curaçao.

name: Aboikonie Zwembad Bedrijf
description: Aboikonie Zwembad Bedrijf is a swimming pool contractor at Sapakarastraat 37 in Latour, Paramaribo, active since 2012. It designs and builds custom concrete pools, builds cabanas and provides pool maintenance, and it is not a public swimming pool.

name: Abrix Cleaning Services
description: Abrix Cleaning Services is a professional cleaning company in Suriname offering commercial and residential cleaning, deep cleaning and facility maintenance services.

name: ABS CARHOUSE
description: ABS Carhouse NV is a car dealer with a showroom at Kwattaweg 367 in Paramaribo, selling new cars from brands including Toyota.

name: AC bar & restaurant
description: AC Bar & Restaurant in Paramaribo serves Brazilian-inspired food and cocktails, with caipirinhas as the house speciality. The menu covers grilled meats, snacks and a solid drinks list, popular for after-work drinks and weekend social dining.

name: Academie voor Hoger Kunst- en Cultuuronderwijs (AHKCO)
description: AHKCO is Suriname's only higher-education academy for the arts, offering bachelor programmes in visual arts, journalism and social work from its Waterkant campus.

name: Academisch Ziekenhuis Paramaribo
description: Academisch Ziekenhuis Paramaribo is the academic hospital at Flustraat 1 in Paramaribo, affiliated with the medical faculty of the Anton de Kom Universiteit van Suriname. It is the largest hospital in Suriname, with the main emergency department, most specialist departments and a range of outpatient clinics.

name: Access Suriname Travel
description: Access Suriname Travel is a Paramaribo travel agency and tour operator offering guided tours, hotel bookings, visa assistance and travel packages for visitors exploring Suriname.

name: Accounting & Management Software N.V.
description: Accounting & Management Software N.V. is a technology and media company serving Suriname, offering accounting and software development.

name: ACE designs & more n.v.
description: ACE Designs & More is a design company on Ronaldlaan in Paramaribo, founded in 2008, offering graphic design, advertising and promotional products, and event management.

name: Ace Restaurant Lounge
description: Ace Restaurant & Lounge is a stylish dining and social space in Paramaribo offering international cuisine, cocktails and a lively evening atmosphere. Popular for after-work drinks and special occasions.

name: ACM Financial Services
description: ACM Financial Services is a financial consultancy at Krikostraat 12 in the Morgenstond area of Paramaribo. The firm offers accounting and financial advice to businesses and private clients. Contact it on +597 866-1433 or info@acmfinserv.com, or see acmfinserv.com.

name: ACT Contractors N.V.
description: ACT Contractors N.V. is a construction and engineering company in Paramaribo offering building and civil construction, renovation, design and build, heavy equipment rental, landscaping, cleaning services and project consulting. Its projects include agricultural, resort, residential and telecommunications work in several districts of Suriname.

name: ActionINVEST Caribbean Inc.
description: ActionINVEST Caribbean Inc. is an ISO certified business development firm offering training, coaching and business support services, listed at Verlengde Gemenelandsweg 95 in Paramaribo.

name: Adept N.V.
description: Adept N.V. is a software company at Surinamestraat 21 in Paramaribo that develops custom software, mobile applications, Windows applications, websites and e-commerce solutions. It also provides hosting and online marketing services such as social media, newsletters and search engine optimisation.

name: ADEX N.V.
description: ADEX N.V. buys, sells and trades in used vehicles and handles the import and export of goods, based at Kalpoeweg 8A in Uitvlucht, Paramaribo.

name: Advanced Geodetic Solutions
description: Advanced Geodetic Solutions is a land surveying firm based in Paramaribo that carries out geodetic surveys of land parcels. It appears on the list of land surveyors registered with MI-GLIS, the Surinamese institute for land registration and land information.

name: Advocatenkantoor Tjong A Sie
description: Advocatenkantoor Tjong A Sie is a law firm at Henck Arronstraat 136 in Paramaribo. It advises on family, divorce and inheritance law, tenancy, employment and property law, and also offers mediation, corporate legal counsel and debt collection services.

name: Afobaka Resort
description: Afobaka Resort is a nature resort in Brokopondo, just beyond the Afobaka Dam on the Suriname River near the Brokopondo Reservoir, offering overnight stays, private lodges and day passes.

name: Afriki
description: Afriki is an Afro dance school founded in 2018 by Winston Adaba, offering Afro dance classes for children, teens and adults at several locations in Paramaribo and Wanica.

name: Afzal Transport
description: Afzal Transport provides passenger transport by bus in Paramaribo and across Suriname, including VIP transport, crew transport and airport transfers.

name: Agile Allies Consultancy N.V.
description: Agile Allies Consultancy N.V. is an IT consultancy at Alatrosstraat 39 in Paramaribo that helps businesses move from business challenges to IT and business solutions.

name: Agrofix N.V.
description: Agrofix N.V. is a pest management company at Verlengde Hooge Straat 22 in Paramaribo that operates as Alpha Control. It focuses on preventing pests and, when needed, controlling them in homes and offices.

name: Akash Bouwmarkt
description: Akash Bouwmarkt is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tiles, sanitary ware and plumbing supplies. Located at Leysweg 27.

name: Akira Overwater Resort
description: Akira Overwater Resort offers detached overwater lodges in the Bigi Pan Nature Reserve, one of Suriname's largest wetland areas. Lodges are built directly over the water with spacious balconies overlooking the lake. Bigi Pan is a significant wildlife and birdwatching area, and the resort provides boat access into the reserve. Accessible by road and boat from Paramaribo.

name: A.K.S CAR CENTER
description: A.K.S CAR CENTER is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, shipping and import. Located at Sophia's lust/Gadradjcoeseinweg. no114.

name: Alafasi Botopasi Lodge
description: A nature lodge at Botopasi on the Upper Suriname River, sold mainly as three and four day packages that include bus transfer to Atjoni, the boat onward, meals and activities. The programme takes in a Maroon museum and village visit, the Tapawatra rapids and their natural jacuzzi, a climb up Ananasberg, and water activities on the river. There is a swimming pool on site.

name: Alegria
description: Alegria is an ice cream shop and snack restaurant at Keizerstraat 49 in Paramaribo, serving ice cream since 1983 along with burgers, wings, shoarma, fried chicken and local dishes such as bami, nasi and moksi alesi.

name: Alidjan Supermarkt & Slijterij
description: Alidjan Supermarkt & Slijterij is a supermarket and liquor store at Nieuw Weergevondenweg 86 in Paramaribo, selling groceries, household goods and drinks, with frequent sales. Contact +597 863-8338.

name: Alis Drugstore
description: Ali's Drugstore on Tourtonnelaan in Paramaribo has been in business since 1948, selling drugstore and medical supply items such as first aid kits, plus agricultural supplies and school and office supplies.

name: Alkebuland Resort
description: Alkebuland Resort is a recreation and events resort at Arubaweg 1a in Para, a short drive from Paramaribo. It was listed as Alkebuland Evenementen Resort among the recreation sites in Para approved for the 2023 holiday period.

name: All Interior Solutions N.V.
description: All Interior Solutions N.V. on Bladwespstraat in Paramaribo designs, delivers and installs custom interior concepts for homes and offices, specialising in project and office furnishing.

name: All Suriname Tours
description: All Suriname Tours is a Paramaribo tour operator running jungle trips, wildlife spotting and multi-day round tours across the interior, with its own booking site at allsurinametours.com.

name: Alliance Francaise
description: Alliance Française Paramaribo is the official French cultural institute in Suriname, offering French language courses, cultural events and exchanges between Suriname and the francophone world.

name: AlphaMax Academy
description: AlphaMax Academy is a private international school on Stanvastestraat in Paramaribo, founded in 1998, offering an English-language international curriculum from kindergarten to grade 13.

name: AlphaPro International N.V.
description: AlphaPro International N.V. is a manufacturer and distributor of chemical products at Magentaweg 41 in De Nieuwe Grond, Wanica. The company also repairs and services measuring devices and instruments and carries out analytical laboratory testing for businesses. Contact +597 583-881.
address: Magentaweg 41, De Nieuwe Grond, Wanica, Suriname

name: Amada Shopping
description: Amada Shopping is a retail centre in Paramaribo with shops and services under one roof. A practical stop for everyday shopping needs.

name: Amazone International NV
description: Amazone International N.V. is a food and non-food wholesaler and distributor on Nieuwe Charlesburgweg 132 in Paramaribo, part of the Amazone group with wholesale, foodservice, frozen and shipping supply divisions.

name: Amazonica Bungalows
description: Six bungalows on Somaiweg in Wanica, open since 2016. Each has three bedrooms, a living room, two bathrooms, a balcony with hammocks and a terrace. The grounds have an infinity pool, garden, bar and restaurant, with a free shuttle service and security on site around the clock.

name: Amit's Sport Café
description: Amit's Sport Café is a sports bar and café on Pandit Murliweg 21 in Nieuw Meerzorg, Commewijne, with seating indoors and outside. It is a local spot to watch matches with drinks and snacks, and it stays open late, until midnight most nights and later on busy weekends.

name: An Shun International NV
description: An Shun International NV is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tyres and repairs. Located at Kwattaweg # 811A.

name: Anaula Nature Resort
description: Anaula Nature Resort is a riverside eco-lodge in the Surinamese interior offering jungle cabins, wildlife watching, guided treks and authentic Maroon cultural experiences on the banks of the Suriname River.

name: AndJiro's
description: AndJiro's is a restaurant on the Nassylaan in Paramaribo, paired with Lodi's Bar, serving meat, fish and vegan dishes in a relaxed setting. Plates are carefully presented and backed by a cocktail menu, and the kitchen opens for dinner in the evening. The bar hosts themed nights such as karaoke and networking evenings.

name: Angelo Services Suriname
description: Angelo Services is an administration and accounting office on Santopolderweg in Wanica that serves Surinamese entrepreneurs and handles outsourced administration, mainly for Dutch organisations.

name: Anil Store
description: Anil Store is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tiles, sanitary ware and plumbing supplies. Located at GEMENELANDSWEG 60.

name: Anjuli Nature Resort
description: A private resort on Libanonweg at Lelydorp, roughly 23 km from Paramaribo, rented out as a whole for quiet stays. It also trades as Anjuli Exotic.

name: Ans Car Imports
description: Ans Car Imports is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, shipping and import. Located at Sophia'slustweg 160.

name: Anthony's Corner
description: Anthony's Corner sits on the corner of Domineestraat and Steenbakkerijstraat in central Paramaribo, serving local and international dishes and well known for its sandwiches.

name: Anton De Kom Universiteit Van Suriname
description: Anton de Kom University of Suriname is the country's national university, offering bachelor's and master's programmes across faculties including medicine, social sciences, economics and technology.

name: ANTS N.V.
description: ANTS N.V. (All Network Technologies Suriname) is an ICT company at Belemstraat 2 in Bennies Park, Paramaribo, specialising in networking, cybersecurity, cloud, hardware and software solutions.

name: Apetina Eco River Resort
description: A jungle lodge at Apetina, also known as Puleowime, on the Tapanahony River in south-east Suriname. The village of roughly 500 people is largely Wayana, Trio and Aparai, and is reached only by light aircraft from Paramaribo or a four to five hour boat trip from Godo Olo. The resort has ten twin rooms with polished timber walls, four with private bathrooms, and runs forest hikes, birdwatching and cultural programmes.

name: Apex Bold
description: Apex Bold is a Surinamese design and fashion brand selling handmade men's accessories made with natural gemstones and stainless steel.

name: Apintie Suriname
description: Apintie Suriname is a broadcaster on Verlengde Gemenelandsweg in Paramaribo operating Radio Apintie and Apintie Televisie. The radio station first went on air in 1958 and broadcasts on 97.1 FM and 91.7 FM, while television broadcasting began in 1997.

name: Apotheek Joemmanbaks
description: Apotheek Joemmanbaks is a pharmacy at Franchepanestraat 120 in Paramaribo, dispensing prescription medicines and over-the-counter products and giving pharmaceutical advice. Customers can also contact the pharmacy through its WhatsApp service.

name: Apotheek Karis
description: Apotheek Karis is a pharmacy and drugstore at Abraham P.H. Samson Straat 14 in Paramaribo. It supplies prescription and over-the-counter medicines, along with a range of health products and personal care items.

name: Apotheek Mac Donald Tourtonnelaan
description: Apotheek Mac Donald is a pharmacy at Tourtonnelaan 29 in Paramaribo, the main branch of the Mac Donald pharmacy, dispensing prescriptions and selling over-the-counter medicines and health products. It is open Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 19:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 13:00. A second branch is in Zorg en Hoop.

name: Apotheek Mac Donald Zorg en Hoop
description: Apotheek Mac Donald Zorg en Hoop is the second branch of the Mac Donald pharmacy, at Madeliefjesstraat 31 in the Zorg en Hoop area of Paramaribo. It dispenses prescriptions and sells over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and personal care products. The main branch is at Tourtonnelaan 29.
address: Madeliefjesstraat 31, Zorg en Hoop, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Apotheek Rafeka
description: Apotheek Rafeka is a pharmacy located in Hermitage Mall on Estreliastraat in Paramaribo. It provides prescription medicines, over-the-counter remedies, homeopathic products and dietary supplements, and its pharmacists offer pharmaceutical advice to customers.

name: Apotheek Sibilo
description: Apotheek Sibilo is a community pharmacy in Paramaribo dispensing prescription medications, OTC drugs, vitamins and health supplements, alongside personal care products. Qualified pharmacists available for medication queries and advice.

name: Apotheek Soma
description: Apotheek Soma is a pharmacy at Dr. Axwijkstraat 107 in northern Paramaribo, operated by N.V. Soma. It dispenses and prepares medicines, gives pharmaceutical advice, offers health checks and a delivery service, and shares medicine information through its website and app.

name: Apotheek Soma Ringweg
description: Apotheek Soma Ringweg is a pharmacy at Ringweg-Zuid 243 in Paramaribo and part of N.V. Soma, which also runs a pharmacy on Dr. Axwijkstraat. It dispenses prescription medicines and sells everyday health and personal care products.

name: APPTASTIC N.V.
description: Apptastic is an ISO 9001 certified software company on Overbrugweg in Lelydorp, specialising in business process re-engineering, custom app development and the implementation of enterprise apps and AI models.
address: Overbrugweg laatste gebouw, Lelydorp, Wanica, Suriname

name: Araxs Impex NV
description: Araxs Impex NV is a business in Wanica, Suriname, offering customs clearance, import and wholesale distribution. Located at Jfk Hwy 130.

name: ARCHER
description: ARCHER is an ICT retailer at Wanicaweg 7 in Paramaribo selling laptops, PCs, TVs, monitors, smart gadgets and accessories. It also runs an ICT service center for laptop repair and technical support, and offers delivery to homes and offices.

name: Ardac International
description: Ardac International on Martin Luther Kingweg in Paramaribo makes handcrafted wooden souvenirs, business gifts, awards and signs, and offers large format printing and pad printing.
address: Martin Luther Kingweg Br. 290, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Argos Suriname
description: Argos Suriname, part of the Colombian cement group Grupo Argos, supplies cement and building materials from Vensurlaan 8 in Paramaribo.

name: ARREX GROUP N.V.
description: ARREX GROUP N.V. on Martin Luther Kingweg in Paramaribo has imported and distributed automotive and industrial products since 2017, including REXOIL lubricants, GRUPEL, WALTHER and Pewag lifting systems.

name: Art Sabina Design & Printing N.V.
description: Art Sabina Design & Printing N.V. is a technology and media company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering design and printing. Located at Zwartenhovenbrugstraat 146.

name: Artemis Energy Suriname N.V
description: Artemis Energy Suriname N.V is an industrial and energy company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering logistics, oil and gas services and energy solutions. Located at Kwattaweg 223.

name: Arthur Alex Hoogendoorn Atheneum
description: Arthur Alex Hoogendoorn Atheneum is a pre-university (VWO) secondary school at Commewijnestraat 12 in Paramaribo, run by Stichting De Vrije School. Founded in 1962 and formerly known as the Vrije Atheneum, it has a lower and an upper section.

name: Ashley Furniture HomeStore
description: Ashley Furniture HomeStore is the Suriname franchise of the American furniture chain, carrying sofas, dining sets, bedroom furniture, mattresses and home décor. The largest furniture brand represented in Suriname, with a showroom-style floor in Paramaribo.

name: Asomena Travel & Tours
description: Asomena Travel & Tours is a tour operator based at Parijsstraat 10 in Paramaribo, organising day and multi-day trips into the Suriname interior. Its tours include stays at Koh I Sa Tang Resort on an island in the Suriname River, with some itineraries visiting Tapawatra Falls and the Ananasgebergte.

name: Assuria Hermitage High Rise
description: Assuria N.V. is Suriname's largest insurance group, offering life and non-life insurance products. The Hermitage High Rise office provides the full range of Assuria's insurance and financial services.

name: Assuria Walk-in City
description: Assuria Insurance Walk-in City is a convenient walk-in branch of Suriname's largest insurer in central Paramaribo, offering quick access to life and non-life insurance products and claims services.

name: Assuria Walk-in Commewijne
description: Assuria Walk-in Commewijne is an Assuria insurance office at Oost-Westverbinding BR 152 in Meerzorg, Commewijne. At this walk-in branch customers can arrange life, health, car, home, travel, accident and business insurance from the Assuria group.

name: Assuria Walk-in Lelydorp
description: Assuria Walk-in Lelydorp is an Assuria insurance office at De Craneweg 2 in Lelydorp, Wanica. At this walk-in branch customers can arrange life, health, car, home, travel, accident and business insurance from the Assuria group.

name: Assuria Walk-in Nickerie
description: Assuria Walk-in Nickerie is an Assuria insurance office at R.P. Bharosstraat 68 in Nickerie. At this walk-in branch customers can arrange life, health, car, home, travel, accident and business insurance from the Assuria group.

name: Assuria Walk-in Noord
description: Assuria Walk-in Noord is an Assuria insurance office at Jozef Israëlstraat 35 in northern Paramaribo. At this walk-in branch customers can arrange life, health, car, home, travel, accident and business insurance from the Assuria group.

name: Atlantis Hotel Casino
description: Atlantis Hotel & Casino is a hotel and gaming destination in Paramaribo offering rooms alongside casino entertainment, dining and event facilities in a central city location.

name: Atlas Fitness Center
description: Atlas Fitness Center is a fitness and wellness centre in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering training courses, gym facilities and martial arts training. Located at Aquariusstraat 200.

name: ATV Suriname
description: ATV Suriname, short for Algemene Televisie Verzorging, is a television broadcaster at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 58-60 in Paramaribo. It airs news, sports, entertainment and educational programmes and offers a livestream of its broadcasts online.

name: Augis Travel
description: Augis Travel is a Surinamese travel agency offering flight bookings, holiday packages and personalised travel services. Experienced in outbound travel and Suriname-based tourism arrangements.

name: Australian Laboratory Services Suriname N.V.
description: Australian Laboratory Services Suriname N.V. is an industrial and energy company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering testing and certification. Located at Parasolmierstraat no. 2528.
address: Parasolmierstraat no. 2528, Loods 2, Geyersvlijt, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Auto Style Franchepanestraat
description: Auto Style Franchepanestraat is a car accessories retailer in Paramaribo carrying audio equipment, seat covers, car care products and vehicle customisation accessories. Serves drivers in the Franchepane corridor.

name: Auto Style Johannes Mungrastraat
description: Auto Style on Johannes Mungrastraat is an automotive accessories and car care shop serving Paramaribo drivers with seat covers, sound systems, LED kits and detailing products. Central location makes it easy to stop in during a city run.

name: Auto Style Kwatta
description: Auto Style Kwatta is a car accessories and detailing retailer in the Kwatta area of Paramaribo, carrying seat covers, audio gear, LED lighting, car care products and vehicle styling accessories. A practical stop for drivers wanting to upgrade or maintain their vehicles.

name: Auto Style Tweede Rijweg
description: Auto Style Tweede Rijweg carries automotive accessories, car care products and vehicle customisation parts for drivers in and around the Tweede Rijweg area of Paramaribo. Stock covers seat covers, audio, lighting and detailing supplies.

name: Auto Style Verlengde Gemenelandsweg
description: Auto Style on Verlengde Gemenelandsweg is an automotive accessories retailer in Paramaribo stocking car care products, interior accessories, audio gear and vehicle styling parts. Convenient for drivers in the south of the city.

name: Automotive Art Suriname
description: Automotive Art Suriname sells automotive paints and car care products from its stores on Kasabaholoweg and Louiselaan in Paramaribo, and through its own webshop.

name: AutoRadar Suriname
description: AutoRadar Suriname is an online car marketplace that brings together vehicles for sale from various car dealers in Suriname. Its office is at Otto Pengelstraat 3 in Paramaribo.

name: Awarradam Jungle Lodge
description: Awarradam Jungle Lodge is a jungle lodge run by METS on Awarradam island, at the foot of the Awarradam rapids on the Gran Rio in the Boven-Suriname area. Guests fly from Zorg en Hoop to the Kajana airstrip and cross the river by canoe, and stays include guided jungle walks and boat trips.

name: Ayo River Lounge
description: Ayo River Lounge is a scenic riverside dining and drinks spot in Paramaribo, offering beautiful views of the Suriname River alongside cocktails and light bites. A romantic setting ideal for sundowners.
address: Ayo River Lounge, Plantage Ayo, Carolina

name: Ayur Mi Beauty Wellness
description: Ayur Mi Beauty & Wellness is a Surinamese spa and beauty centre offering Ayurvedic-inspired treatments, massages and natural beauty services in Paramaribo.

name: B-FIT Sportschool
description: B-FIT Sportschool is a fitness studio at Willem Anthonielaan 1 in Paramaribo. It offers gym facilities and a range of group workouts, including aerobic classes, Zumba, HIIT sessions and weight loss programmes.

name: B Malhoe & sons
description: B. Malhoe & Sons N.V. is a store at Frederik Derbystraat 103-105 in Paramaribo selling building materials, plumbing and electrical supplies and hardware.

name: B. Singh Trading
description: B. Singh Trading is a furniture and electronics store in Paramaribo, Suriname, selling TVs, kitchen appliances, furniture, mattresses and household goods. Located at Lakhnauweg #23-27.

name: Babel Food Resort
description: Babel Food Resort is a foundation based near Republiek in Para that develops healthy food products from traditional Surinamese crops such as cassava and runs food processing workshops. It also runs an organic agriculture and agro-tourism project at Kwakoegron in Brokopondo together with local Matawai communities.

name: Baitali Group
description: Baitali Group is a Surinamese group of companies based at Duisburglaan 29 in Paramaribo, with a location in Nickerie and origins dating to 1953. Its businesses cover civil construction and infrastructure, asphalt production, mining, heavy equipment rental, transport, utility network services and rice production.

name: Baka Foto Restaurant
description: Baka Foto Restaurant sits across the Suriname River from central Paramaribo, reached by a short ferry crossing that's part of the experience. Known for Surinamese and Creole cooking in a historical waterfront setting, with an open-air terrace overlooking the river.

name: Bakaaboto Nature Resort
description: A back-to-basics nature resort at the foot of the Bakaaboto rapids on the Upper Suriname River, south of the Brokopondo reservoir and about 185 km from Paramaribo. Cabins are available with or without private bathrooms, and day guests can rent tents and cooking gear. Dugout canoe trips run to the Saamaka villages of Duwata and Bekyookndé.

name: Baker Hughes
description: Baker Hughes is an industrial and energy company serving Suriname, offering energy solutions.

name: Balance Studio
description: Balance Studio is a dedicated fitness and wellness studio in Paramaribo offering yoga, pilates and mindful movement classes. A calm, supportive environment for improving flexibility, strength and mental wellbeing.

name: Balletschool Charlotte Sprangers
description: Balletschool Charlotte Sprangers is a training and education provider in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering dance classes. Located at Dr. J.F. Nassylaan 44.

name: Balletschool Marlene
description: Balletschool Marlene is Suriname's premier ballet school in Paramaribo, offering classical ballet training for children and adults from beginner to advanced levels.

name: Bamboo Adventure Tours
description: Bamboo Adventure Tours is a Surinamese tour operator based at Maureenlaan 27 in Paramaribo. It runs all-inclusive day trips and longer tours into the interior, such as a one-day Brownsberg tour, with discounts for groups. Bookings can be made online or by phone on +597 813-2435.

name: Banking Network Suriname N.V.
description: Banking Network Suriname N.V. (BNETS) owns the Surinamese interbank network that lets bank cardholders pay by debit card at shops and withdraw cash at the ATMs of the different banks. Its office is at Kasabaholoweg 29, Paramaribo.

name: Bar Qle
description: Bar Qle is a cocktail bar and lounge in Paramaribo known for inventive drinks, a lively social scene and regular themed events. The kind of place that fills up after 9pm on weekends, with a crowd that skews young and sociable.

name: Bar Zuid
description: Bar Zuid is a bar and casual restaurant in Paramaribo serving pizzas, burgers and cold drinks in a neighbourhood setting. Draws a mixed local crowd. Families tend to arrive earlier in the evening, with a more social scene later on.

name: BB Energy
description: BB Energy is an industrial and energy company serving Suriname, offering logistics, energy solutions and trading.
address: Jumeirah Lake Towers AG Silver Tower, , Cluster 1 32nd Floor

name: BBQ Bar
description: BBQ Bar is a restaurant at Plutostraat 118 in Paramaribo serving Chinese-style barbecue, including barbecue chicken, spare ribs, wings, squid and mixed seafood. The menu also features soups, fried rice and fried noodles.

name: BDO Suriname
description: BDO Suriname is a professional services firm in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering accounting, tax advice and audit services. Located at Rode Kruislaan #10.

name: BDT Import and Export n.v
description: BDT Import and Export n.v is a business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering import and export. Located at Trachietstraat.

name: Beauty 4 Ever Schoonheidssalon
description: Beauty 4 Ever Schoonheidssalon is a beauty salon on Lallarookhweg 31 in Paramaribo offering facials, pedicures, foot massages, relaxation massages and waxing.

name: Beauty Haven
description: Beauty Haven is a beauty salon at Franchepanestraat 100 in Paramaribo, known on social media for its nail sets and beauty treatments. Appointments are booked online through the salon's booking page or by phone on +597 850-9895.

name: Beauty Haven Paradise

name: Beton Bedrijf Nathoo
description: Beton Bedrijf Nathoo is a concrete company at Duisburglaan 91-92 in Paramaribo, supplying concrete and cement products for construction work. Contractors and private builders can reach it on +597 811-2220.

name: Beyrouth Bazaar
description: Beyrouth Bazaar is a Lebanese-owned general trading store in central Paramaribo carrying a broad mix of clothing, textiles, cosmetics, household goods and imported products. Known for competitive prices and a wide, unpredictable inventory, it draws bargain hunters and shoppers looking for everything from fabrics to everyday household essentials.

description: Bhondoekhan S n.v. is an auto parts importer and store at Weg naar Ma-Retraite 14 in Paramaribo. It imports vehicle parts and supplies a range of replacement parts and performance upgrades, and is also known as Handelsonderneming S. Bhondoekhan N.V.

name: Big Tex
description: Big Tex is a Texas-style barbecue joint on Anamoestraat in Paramaribo. The kitchen smokes brisket on-site for 17 hours over hickory and builds Certified Angus Beef smash burgers, brisket sandwiches, cilantro-garlic fries and Mexican-style grilled corn. Two-time winner of the Asruf Burger Battle. Not Surinamese cooking: this is American BBQ made in Suriname.

name: Bingo Pizza Coppename

description: Bingo Pizza Kwatta brings the popular local pizza brand to Suriname's Kwatta district. Known for large, affordable pizzas and reliable delivery.

description: Bio with Wirjo Tours Suriname is a Paramaribo tour company founded by former biology teacher Ricky Wirjosentono. It runs guided nature and wildlife trips, including birdwatching, rainforest and river tours, as well as walking tours of historic Paramaribo and educational workshops on sustainability for schools and companies.

name: BioMedical Systems N.V.
description: BioMedical Systems N.V. supplies and installs advanced medical devices for the healthcare sector in Suriname, working from Gravenberchstraat 23 in Paramaribo since 1998.

description: Bistro Don Julio is a cosy Latin-inspired bistro in Paramaribo serving tapas, grills and international small plates. An intimate venue perfect for relaxed dining.

name: Bistro Lequatorze
description: Bistro L'Equatorze is a refined French-inspired bistro in Paramaribo offering classic European dishes, fine wines and a warm dining atmosphere. A favourite for special occasions.

name: Bit Dynamics N.V.
description: Bit Dynamics N.V. is a software development company in Paramaribo founded in January 2012. The firm builds websites, web applications, mobile apps and digital signage solutions, and provides web hosting and technical support. Clients are primarily businesses in Suriname seeking custom digital solutions.

name: Bits Please Technologies
description: Bits Please Technologies N.V. is a Paramaribo software company that builds websites, webshops, apps and internal business systems, and offers ready-made software products for businesses.

description: Black Eagle Tours has run tailor-made adventure trips in Suriname since 2008, focused on the rainforest interior and indigenous and Maroon communities.

name: Blanche Marie Nature Resort
description: Basic lodge and hammock accommodation at the Blanche Marie falls on the Nickerie River, at the foot of the Bakhuis Mountains in west Suriname. The falls run roughly 120 metres wide, and the surrounding forest is known for its birdlife and all eight of Suriname's monkey species.

name: Blissful Massage Aromatherapy
description: Blissful Massage & Aromatherapy is a holistic wellness practice on Anton Dragtenweg in Paramaribo. It offers relaxing massages, aromatherapy with essential oils and special treatments such as womb-healing massage. Clients rate it highly, and appointments are made by phone on +597 885-5784.

Open from 8 PM, it’s the perfect place to mingle, meet and greet, and enjoy the tropical Surinamese nightlife.

It has one of the largest followings of any salon in Suriname and serves clients in Dutch, English, Sranan Tongo and Spanish.

name: Gossip Nails Xx
description: Gossip Nails XX is a trendy nail salon in Paramaribo offering creative nail art, gel extensions, acrylic nails and nail care treatments. Known for on-trend designs and quality work.

name: GOw2 Energy Suriname
description: GOw2 Energy Suriname is a fuel company and subsidiary of Staatsolie that operates service stations in Suriname, including the former Texaco network acquired from Chevron in 2011. It supplies gasoline, diesel, Jet A-1 and lubricants, with its head office at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 27A in Paramaribo.

name: GPA Automotive
description: GPA Automotive is an automotive business based in Paramaribo, Suriname. Located at Schietbaanweg 75.

name: GPSSR
description: GPSSR is a GPS tracking and fleet management platform based at Meerzorgweg 36 in Meerzorg, Commewijne, giving businesses real-time tools to monitor their vehicles.

name: Grant Thornton Suriname
description: Grant Thornton Suriname is a professional services firm at Flustraat 31 in Paramaribo, providing assurance, tax, advisory and business process services.

name: Grassalco
description: Grassalco is a state-owned mining company in Suriname, based in Paramaribo. It is active in gold mining, including at its Maripaston concession, and in construction materials such as crushed stone and silica sand.

name: Great Wall Motor Suriname
description: Great Wall Motor Suriname is the official GWM dealership, offering a range of Chinese-engineered SUVs and pickup trucks. Providing sales, service and parts for the growing GWM vehicle range.

name: Green Village Resort
description: Apartments in a quiet green setting on Livornoweg in the south of Paramaribo. Units have fully equipped kitchens, private bathrooms, air conditioning and balconies over the garden, and there is a year-round outdoor pool, a terrace and free private parking. Zorg en Hoop airport is about five kilometres away.

name: Greenheart Boutique Hotel
description: Greenheart Boutique Hotel is a design-forward eco-conscious hotel in Paramaribo. Using sustainable materials and local craftsmanship, it offers stylish rooms, a garden terrace and a personalised stay that celebrates Surinamese natural heritage.

name: Grounded Botanical Studio
description: Grounded Botanical Studio is a Surinamese plant and lifestyle boutique offering indoor plants, terrariums, botanical gifts and plant care accessories. A green sanctuary for plant lovers.

name: Guesthouse Albergo Alberga
description: Albergo Alberga is an intimate guesthouse in Paramaribo set in a restored historic building. Offering characterful rooms, warm service and a convenient city-centre location, it is a favourite among culturally curious travellers.

name: Guesthouse Albina
description: Guesthouse Albina provides clean, affordable accommodation in Albina, Suriname's border town with French Guiana. A practical base for travellers crossing into French Guiana or exploring the Marowijne region.

name: Guesthouse Amice
description: A ten-room guesthouse on Gravenberchstraat in Paramaribo. Rooms are air conditioned and non-smoking, and the property has an outdoor pool, a well-kept garden, a bar, bicycle hire, parking and space for small conferences.

name: Guguplex Technologies S.A.C.
description: Guguplex Technologies S.A.C. is a solar engineering company on Henck Arronstraat in Paramaribo, supplying solar home systems such as SunKing units.

name: Gum Air
description: Gum Air is an airline based at Zorg en Hoop Airport on Doekhieweg Oost in Paramaribo, operating domestic charter flights to airstrips in the Surinamese interior as well as flights to Guyana and French Guiana. The company also offers ticketing, ground handling, maintenance, refuelling and cargo handling services.

name: Gunsi Eco Resort Tei Wei
description: A hillside eco resort on the island village of Gunsi in the Upper Suriname River, about an hour and a half by canoe from Atjoni. Tei Wei runs three and four day packages covering transport, meals, village walks and guides, and footpaths lead from Gunsi through to Laduani, Tjaikonde and Nieuw Aurora. There is river swimming at the resort and a WWF nature trail running kilometres into the forest.

name: Guru Rotishop
description: Guru Rotishop on Sir Winston Churchillweg serves heerlijke oso nyang and belegde broden, the everyday Surinamese home cooking locals pick up for lunch.

name: Gym Boss Fitness Center
description: Gym Boss Fitness Center is a fitness and wellness centre in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering training courses and gym facilities. Located at Mahonylaan #51.

name: H. Bromet Shipping Agency NV
description: H. Bromet Shipping N.V. is a ship, liner and port agency at Domineestraat 34 in Paramaribo. Founded in 1936 as a family leather trading firm, it also represents the PAS Cargo brand in Suriname.

name: H Garden
description: H Garden, based at Leiding 9 in Wanica, sells natural Surinamese products such as wood vinegar (houtazijn), charcoal, wood tar, honey and natural juices.

name: Habco Delight
description: Habco Delight is the takeaway counter of Habco Fisheries on Gemenelandsweg in Paramaribo, and it is fish first. Kibbeling with fries or cassava, heri heri with salted or fried fish, moksi alesi with kibbeling, plus fish sticks, crab pastries and fish burgers. Fresh, salted and fried fish, shrimp and crab are also sold over the counter.

name: Habco Delight North
description: Habco Delight North is the Aidastraat branch of the Habco Fisheries takeaway in northern Paramaribo. Same fish-led menu: kibbeling, fried and salted fish, heri heri, crab pastries, fish sticks and fish burgers, plus fresh fish and shrimp to take home.

name: Splendora Hair & Beauty
description: A hair and beauty salon in Paramaribo, trading as Splendora Hair & Beauty.

name: Hairfreak Barbershop
description: A barbershop in Paramaribo specialising in fresh fades and men's cuts.

name: Hairstudio 32
description: Hairstudio 32 is a hair salon in Paramaribo offering cuts, colour, treatments and styling for women. Known for technical colour work and personalised styling, with a regular clientele that books ahead for appointment slots.

name: Hairstudio Dawson N.V.
description: Hairstudio Dawson N.V. is a hair and nail salon in the Torarica Arcade on Mr. L.J. Rietbergplein in central Paramaribo. See hairstudiodawson.com for its services and appointments.

name: Hakrinbank Hoofdkantoor
description: Hakrinbank's head office on Dr. Sophie Redmondstraat in Paramaribo offers personal and business banking, including accounts, loans, mortgages and digital banking. The bank describes itself as the number 1 business bank in Suriname.

name: Hakrinbank Flora
description: Hakrinbank Flora is a Hakrinbank branch on Mr. Jagernath Lachmonstraat in the Flora area of Paramaribo, offering personal and business banking services.

name: Hakrinbank Latour
description: Hakrinbank Latour serves the Latour area of Paramaribo with the full range of Hakrinbank's personal and business banking products and services.

name: Hakrinbank Nickerie
description: Hakrinbank Nickerie is the Hakrinbank branch at G.G. Maynardstraat 19 in Nieuw Nickerie, offering personal and business banking services in the Nickerie district.

name: Hakrinbank Nieuwe Haven
description: Hakrinbank Nieuwe Haven is a Hakrinbank branch in the Nieuwe Haven area of Paramaribo, offering personal and business banking services.

name: Hakrinbank Tamanredjo
description: Hakrinbank Tamanredjo is a branch of Hakrinbank at Hadji Iding Soemitaweg 471 in Tamanredjo, Commewijne. The branch serves customers with the bank's personal and business banking services, such as accounts, loans, savings and foreign currency services.

name: Hakrinbank Tourtonne
description: Hakrinbank Tourtonne is a branch of Hakrinbank on the corner of Anamoestraat and Plutostraat in the Tourtonne area of Paramaribo. The branch serves customers with the bank's personal and business banking services, such as accounts, loans, savings and foreign currency services.
address: Corner of Anamoestraat and Plutostraat, Paramaribo

name: Hammer & Nail Trading
description: Hammer & Nail Trading is a building materials store at Indira Gandhiweg 239 in Paramaribo, specialising in kiln-dried doors, quality timber and building materials for more than 25 years.

name: Han Palace
description: Han Palace is a traditional Chinese health center in northern Paramaribo. Its therapists specialise in traditional Chinese massage techniques and acupuncture treatments.

name: Handelmaatschappij B.Sewnath N.V
description: Handelmaatschappij B.Sewnath N.V. is a building materials store on Jozef Israelstraat in Paramaribo, selling cement products, sand, stone, rebar, mesh, lumber, roofing, doors and plumbing supplies.

name: Handelmij Dharmsingh N.V
description: Handelmij Dharmsingh N.V. supplies sand, stone and other bulk building materials from Lingtangweg 37 in Meerzorg, Commewijne, and has more than 30 years of experience.

name: Handelmij R Nanhoe N.V
description: Handelmij R Nanhoe N.V is a business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering building materials and trading. Located at Kwattaweg no 315.

name: Handmade by Farrell N.V.
description: Handmade by Farrell N.V. is a Surinamese organic skincare brand producing cosmetics from locally sourced beeswax, honey, propolis and coconut oil. Products contain no preservatives or synthetic additives and are suited to sensitive skin. Available direct from the brand.

name: Happy Flower Services
description: Happy Flower Services is a florist and flower delivery service in Suriname offering fresh flowers, arrangements and floral gifts for all occasions.

name: River Breeze Domburg / Marina Suriname
description: A marina and resort on the Suriname River at Domburg, about 16 km upstream of Paramaribo. Harbour Resort Domburg combines a yacht marina with a floating dock, free wifi and a water taxi, riverside camping pitches for overlanders, a pool, and the River Breeze restaurant and bar serving seafood and Surinamese dishes over the water.

name: Hard Rock Cafe Suriname
description: Hard Rock Cafe Suriname is the local outlet of the global music and dining brand, serving American-style food and cocktails at the International Mall of Suriname in Paramaribo. A second outlet is in the departure hall of Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport.
address: International Mall of Suriname, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Harry Tjin
description: Harry Tjin is a party and packaging supplies shop at Maagdenstraat 35 in central Paramaribo, selling party decorations, disposables and packaging materials. Contact +597 473-677 or l.tjin@harrytjin.com.

name: HASELHOEF MD Solutions
description: HASELHOEF MD Solutions is an ICT solutions integrator on Lelydorperweg in Lelydorp, serving commercial, industrial, mining and government clients in Suriname and the wider Caribbean and Latin America.

name: N.V. Havenbeheer Suriname
description: N.V. Havenbeheer Suriname is Suriname's port management company, managing the Dr. Jules Sedney Haven in Paramaribo and the Algemene Haven in Nieuw Nickerie. Based at Havenlaan Zuid 5 in Paramaribo, it provides the port facilities through which private companies deliver port services.

name: HBN Law & tax
description: HBN Law & Tax is a legal and tax advisory firm whose Suriname office is at L.B. Smithplein 3 in Paramaribo. The firm also has an office on Curaçao.

name: HCMS N.V.
description: HCMS N.V. (Human Capital Management Solutions) is an employer of record and workforce services company at Bindastraat 68 in Paramaribo, offering recruitment, payrolling and support for expat professionals.

name: HDF Consulting N.V.
description: HDF Consulting N.V. is an ICT solutions company at Matzeligerstraat 16 in Paramaribo, founded in 1996 by Huub and Shirley de Freytas.

name: Health Control Services
description: Health Control Services provides occupational health services for organisations from Waaldijkstraat 115 in Paramaribo, including preventive care and absenteeism management.

name: Heavy Construction Academy Suriname N.V
description: Heavy Construction Academy Suriname N.V. provides safety and technical training, including heavy equipment training, for the mining, construction and oil and gas industries from Marthastraat 69 in Paramaribo.

name: Hello Health N.V.
description: Hello Health N.V. is a wholesaler of medicines, medical supplies and supplements based on Indrawatieweg in Wanica, supplying pharmacies and drugstores. It sells to resellers only.

name: HEM Suriname N.V.
description: HEM Suriname N.V. is an import and distribution company at Hendrikstraat 281 in Paramaribo, supplying a wide range of products and active in Suriname since 1898.

name: HenCom-Trai N.V.
description: HenCom-Trai N.V. is a training institute at Franchepanestraat 29 in Paramaribo that has offered technology and ICT courses for over two decades, for individuals and companies, from basic computer skills to IT certification packages.

name: Hermitage Mall
description: Hermitage Mall is one of Paramaribo's main shopping centres, housing fashion retailers, opticians, electronics, food outlets, a cinema and personal care services across multiple floors. Centrally located with parking, it covers most shopping needs in a single trip.

name: Hertog Taxi & Airport Shuttle Service
description: Hertog Taxi 1688 runs metered taxis and airport shuttles in Paramaribo, with its own booking app and real-time trip tracking, a fixed-price alternative to negotiating at the airport.

name: Hertz Suriname Car Rental
description: Hertz Suriname is the local franchise of the world's most recognised car rental brand, offering a quality fleet of vehicles for hire at competitive rates in Paramaribo.

name: HES DS
description: HES-D's is a barbecue restaurant on Johannes Mungrastraat in Paramaribo, part of the HES-D's BBQ chain serving barbecue, burgers and fries.

name: HES DS 2
description: HES DS 2 is the Latour branch of HES-D's BBQ, located on Latourweg in Paramaribo. It serves barbecued chicken, pork, spare ribs and baby back ribs, along with fries, satay and sausages from its sausage stand.

name: HES DS 3
description: HES DS 3 is the Kwatta branch of HES-D's BBQ, located at Kwattaweg 772 in Paramaribo. It serves barbecued chicken, pork, spare ribs and baby back ribs, along with fries, satay and sausages from its sausage stand.

name: Het Geologisch Museum
description: A museum on the geology and mining history of Suriname, housed in the Geologisch Mijnbouwkundige Dienst building on Jaggernath Lachmonstraat.

name: Het Koto Museum
description: Het Koto Museum in Paramaribo documents the traditional dress of Surinamese Creole women, the koto, through an exhibition of historical garments, photographs and cultural context. A small but focused museum for anyone interested in Suriname's cultural heritage and textile traditions.

name: Higher Heights Imports
description: Higher Heights Imports on Ringweg-Noord in Paramaribo buys and ships online purchases from abroad for customers in Suriname, with or without a credit card, and also keeps stock locally.

name: Highway Automotive Parts
description: Highway Automotive Parts is a car parts store at Martin Luther Kingweg 77 in Paramaribo that also offers car service and repair.
address: Martin Luther King weg 77 , Paramaribo, Suriname

name: HJ de Vries Agro
description: HJ de Vries Agro, part of the HJ Group of Companies, sells crop protection products, fertilisers and seeds from Industrieweg Noord 29 in Paramaribo.

name: HJ Motors
description: HJ Motors is the official importer and distributor of Mazda and Suzuki vehicles, Suzuki Marine outboard motors and parts in Suriname, located at Slangenhoutstraat 46-48 in Paramaribo.

name: Holiday Home Decor
description: Holiday Home Decor is a Paramaribo shop focused on home accessories, seasonal decorations and interior styling pieces, from festive ornaments and wreaths to everyday cushions, frames and accent items. A handy stop for anyone refreshing a living space or hunting for a thoughtful housewarming gift.

name: Holland Lodge
description: Holland Lodge is a small, family-run boutique hotel on Mahonylaan in Paramaribo, a short distance from the sights of the city centre. Guests can explore the city by bike.

name: Hollandia Bakkerij Noord
description: Hollandia Bakkerij North is a branch of the beloved Surinamese bakery chain offering fresh-baked Dutch-Surinamese breads, pastries and savoury items daily in northern Paramaribo.

name: Hollandia Bakkerij Zuid
description: Hollandia Bakkerij South serves southern Paramaribo with fresh daily bread, pastries and traditional Surinamese bakery products from the trusted Hollandia brand.

name: Holsu N.V.
description: Holsu N.V. is a fish processing company at Sir Winston Churchillweg 813 in Domburg, in business since 1995. It operates its own fishing fleet, processes the catch to customers' specifications and runs an automated plant, opened in 2010, that prepares raw material for surimi products for the Japanese market. Contact +597 370-460.

name: Holy Moly
description: Holy Moly is a brunch café on Johannes Mungrastraat in Paramaribo serving Asian-inspired comfort food, known for its egg drop sandwiches and scrambled egg dishes.

name: Honeycare
description: Honeycare is a health and beauty retail shop in Suriname carrying natural personal care products, vitamins, supplements and organic cosmetics. Focused on plant-based and natural formulations, it draws customers looking for an alternative to conventional drugstore products.

name: Honeycare North
description: Honeycare North is the northern Paramaribo branch of the natural health and beauty retailer, offering organic skincare, supplements and wellness products.

name: Honeycare South
description: Honeycare South brings the trusted Honeycare natural health and beauty range to southern Paramaribo, offering organic products and wellness essentials.

name: Hong wei bouwmaterialen
description: Hong wei bouwmaterialen is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering hardware, timber and paint. Located at Anamoestraat 39.

name: Hotel Botopassie
description: Simple riverside bungalows on the Suriname River, reached by bus from Saramaccastraat in Paramaribo and then by boat. Basic but inexpensive, and the journey upriver is much of the appeal.

name: Hotel Cactus II
description: A small hotel on Daniel Ijveraarstraat in Paramaribo.

name: Hotel De Luifel
description: A hotel on Gondastraat in central Paramaribo, close to Independence Square and the Presidential Palace. Rooms have air conditioning and a minibar, and the property has a pool and a lounge.

name: Hotel en Restaurant Concorde
description: A hotel and Javanese restaurant on Wilhelminastraat in Nieuw Nickerie. Rooms have air conditioning, wifi and private bathrooms, and the ground-floor restaurant serves nasi, bami, saoto soup, loempia and bakabana, with parking in front and across the street.

name: Hotel North Resort
description: Hotel North Resort is a comfortable hotel in northern Paramaribo offering rooms, a pool and meeting facilities. Convenient for business travellers and families, it provides reliable amenities at a competitive price point.

name: Hotel Palacio
description: Hotel Palacio is a centrally located hotel in the historic heart of Paramaribo. Housed in a beautifully restored colonial building, it offers comfortable rooms with character, making it an excellent base for exploring the UNESCO World Heritage inner city.

name: Hotel Paramuru
description: A centrally placed hotel on A.L. Waaldijkstraat with 24 rooms and a penthouse, furnished in a traditional Surinamese style. Rooms are air conditioned with a balcony or terrace and private bathroom. There is a 24-hour front desk, a bar, a terrace and free parking. The Central Market is 700 metres away and the Waterkant just over a kilometre.

name: Hotel Peperpot
description: Hotel Peperpot is a unique nature retreat on a former plantation estate in Commewijne, across the river from Paramaribo. Guests stay in restored plantation buildings surrounded by rainforest, with easy access to Peperpot Nature Park and river dolphin tours.

name: Hotel Perola
description: A budget hotel on Prinsessestraat, under three kilometres from the Central Market. Rooms have satellite TV, a work desk and a private bathroom. There is a bar and restaurant, a 24-hour desk, a terrace and shared lounge, laundry and luggage storage, free parking and wifi in the common areas.

name: Hotel Tyche
description: A hotel on Van Idsingaweg in Nieuw Nickerie, formerly trading as Royal. Rooms come with free wifi and a continental breakfast, and the property has a bar, a coffee shop, a terrace and a nightclub, with parking on site.

name: House Of Pureness
description: House of Pureness is a beauty salon and day spa at Veldhuizenlaan 65 in Paramaribo, offering massages and beauty treatments such as MiniLift. It celebrated its 25th anniversary in 2026.

name: Houttuyn Wellness River Resort
description: Houttuyn Wellness River Resort is a river resort in Suriname set in tropical garden grounds along the water, offering villa accommodation, a pool, spa services and a restaurant. About 30 minutes from Paramaribo, it's a popular weekend escape for city residents and visiting guests.

name: HSCS Suriname
description: HSCS N.V. (HQ Service Center Suriname) is a business process outsourcing company at Paardenplein 7 in Paramaribo, active since 2012 and handling administration and customer contact for clients.

name: Hsds Lifestyle Noord
description: HSDS Lifestyle Noord is the Ringweg-Noord store of Home Shopping & Delivery Service (HSDS) in Paramaribo, selling electronics and home appliances, with online ordering through HSDS Online.

name: Hsds Lifestyle Wanica
description: HSDS Lifestyle Wanica is the Indira Gandhiweg store of Home Shopping & Delivery Service (HSDS) in Wanica, selling electronics and home appliances, with online ordering through HSDS Online.

name: BOSS - International Mall of Suriname
description: BOSS - International Mall of Suriname is a store for the fashion brand BOSS, located in Unit C2 + C3 of the International Mall of Suriname at Ringweg-Zuid 245 in Paramaribo. The store sells apparel, footwear and accessories.
address: International Mall of Suriname, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Hummy's Import - ACE CARS SALES
description: Hummy's Import - ACE CARS SALES is a car dealership on Indira Gandhiweg in Paramaribo, offering a wide variety of vehicles at affordable prices.

name: Humus Recruitment N.V.
description: Humus Recruitment N.V. is a recruitment and staffing agency in Paramaribo, providing human resources solutions for employers and job seekers in Suriname and abroad.
address: Dr. J.F. Nassylaan 2, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Hurricane Steel
description: Hurricane Steel manufactures and supplies modern building materials including galvanized steel framing profiles, rolling doors and shutters, aluminum shutters, roofing and wall cladding, drywall, and panels. Operating since 1998, with two locations in Paramaribo.

name: Hurricane Steel (Ringweg Zuid)
description: The Ringweg Zuid branch of Hurricane Steel stocks the company's full range of modern building materials: galvanized steel framing profiles, rolling doors and shutters, aluminum shutters, roofing and wall cladding, drywall, and panels. Convenient pick-up point for projects on the south side of Paramaribo.

name: Huub Explorer Tours
description: Huub Explorer Tours is a Paramaribo-based tour operator offering personalised jungle treks, river tours and off-the-beaten-track adventures into Suriname's interior.

name: Hybris GROUP N.V.
description: Hybris Group N.V. manufactures concrete bricks and paving tiles for the construction industry at Mon Plaisirweg in Wanica. The company was founded in 2021.

name: Iamchede
description: Iamchede is a children's clothing boutique at Parijsstraat 12 in Paramaribo, selling a collection of casual and comfortable clothing for young children. The boutique held its soft opening at this address in October 2025.

name: IAS Wooden and Construction N.V.
description: IAS Wooden and Construction N.V. is a Surinamese construction and carpentry company founded in 2023, working in wood construction, carpentry and building projects. Takes on residential and commercial contracts across Paramaribo and surrounding areas.

name: Ieshaan taxi services
description: Ieshaan Taxi Services & Car Rental is a taxi and car rental company at Rome Street 37 in Paramaribo, offering airport transfers from Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport.

name: IMIT SURINAME
description: IMIT (Institute of Management and Information Technology) is a higher education institute on Zinniastraat 18 in Paramaribo, offering a 4-year bachelor's programme in Business ICT Management.

name: Impressive Suriname Travel N.V.
description: Impressive Suriname Travel has operated since 2020, running tours in Suriname and across the border into French Guiana and Guyana with a focus on local experiences.

name: Indutec Systems N.V.
description: Indutec Systems N.V. is an industrial supplier on Hermesstraat in Paramaribo, official importer of Rymax Lubricants and Brady dealer for lockout/tagout safety products, also selling welding and safety products via its welding.sr online shop.

name: INEFFABLE
description: Ineffable N.V. is a social media and marketing communications agency in Paramaribo founded in October 2016. Services include social media strategy, content creation, video production, advertising management, reporting and analytics, and project management. The agency specialises in helping businesses reach their audiences through digital channels.

name: Infinity Holding
description: INFINITY Holding N.V. is a Surinamese company on Awaralaan in Paramaribo, registered as a holding in 2001, whose activities include alarm and camera security systems.

name: Info2000
description: Info2000 is a technology and media company based in Paramaribo, Suriname. Located at Wanicastraat 129.

name: Ingipipa Park
description: A small eco park and nature retreat on the edge of Paramaribo, with mango trees, still water and cabins for overnight stays. Quiet enough to feel far from the city without leaving it.

name: Inksane Tattoos
description: Inksane Tattoos is a tattoo studio located in Paramaribo, Suriname. The tattoo studio where we use the best of the best tattoo supplies to keep our standards high and a place where you can expect quality.

name: Innovative Driven N.V.
description: Innovative Driven Suriname is an electric vehicle dealership on Zinniastraat in Paramaribo, selling electric cars and SUVs. New models are presented on its Facebook page. Contact +597 895-6560.

name: Inproser N.V.
description: Inproser N.V. is a security company at Virolastraat 4 in Paramaribo that specialises in protecting properties, people and events, and also advises clients on their security. It serves companies in natural resources and other strategic sectors and operates both in Suriname and internationally.

name: Instyle Optics
description: InStyle Optics is a boutique optical and eyewear shop in Paramaribo offering fashionable frames, quality lenses and professional eye care services.

name: Int-Ext Architects N.V
description: Int-Ext Architects N.V. is an architectural design and construction company at Hornilaan 40 in Paramaribo, active in the preparation, design and execution of building projects. The office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:00. Contact +597 891-8101.

name: Integra Marine & Freight Services N.V.
description: Integra Marine & Freight Services N.V. is a shipping and logistics company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering freight forwarding. Located at Van ‘t Hogerhuysstraat 13-15.

name: Integrated Computer Services N.V.
description: Integrated Computer Services N.V. (ICS) is an IT solutions provider and computer store on Van 't Hogerhuysstraat in Paramaribo, established in 1988.

name: Integrated Professional Services N.V.
description: Integrated Professional Services N.V. (IPS) is a software company at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 28 in Paramaribo and part of the Integrated Services Group. It develops FINICS-ERP, an enterprise resource planning system customised for each organisation, which grew out of an accounting application first built in 1993.

name: Interdeco
description: Interdeco Kitchens makes custom kitchens, bath furniture, wardrobes, walk-in closets and shop interiors, with a showroom on Ringweg Noord in Paramaribo.

name: Intergeo
description: Intergeo is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering legal services, property sales and rentals and construction. Located at Wagenwegstraat 15.

name: Intermed Caribe
description: Intermed Caribe, founded in 1999, supplies health, hygiene and safety products to hospitals, laboratories and clinics from Gompertsstraat in Paramaribo, and runs a retail shop in Tamansarie, Commewijne.

name: International Academy Of Suriname
description: International Academy of Suriname (IAS) is a private Christian school on J. S. Lawtonlaan in Paramaribo offering accredited North American education to students from many countries.

name: International Mall of Suriname
description: The International Mall of Suriname (IMS) in Paramaribo is the country's largest shopping centre, housing fashion retailers, electronics stores, supermarkets, food outlets and services under one roof. Anchored by major local and international chains, it's the main destination for big-day shopping in the capital.

name: Intertek International, N.V.
description: Intertek International, N.V. is an industrial and energy company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering testing and certification. Located at Sir Winston Churchillweg.

name: Intervast
description: Intervast is a real estate and construction company, founded in 1994, that sells building plots and builds new homes in Suriname, with its local office at Franchepanestraat 127 in Paramaribo. It also offers property valuation, transfer assistance, renovation, fencing, and property management and rental.

name: Intramar NV

name: Invictus Brazilian Jiu Jitsu
description: Invictus Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is a BJJ and martial arts academy in Paramaribo running classes for all levels from complete beginners to competition fighters. Professional coaching in a structured training environment, with both gi and no-gi classes available.

name: I&R Building Materials
description: I&R Building Materials is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering plumbing supplies, electrical supplies and timber. Located at indira gandhiweg 50-52.

name: IRES Property Agency N.V.
description: IRES Property Agency N.V. is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering property sales and rentals. Located at Wilhelminastraat 91.

name: Ismay van Wilgen Sporthal
description: A sports hall on Gravenberchstraat in Paramaribo, named after Ismay van Wilgen, one of Suriname's leading all-round athletes of the 1960s and 70s.

name: Isotherm-Suriname NV
