description: Lobby is a restaurant at Zonnebloemstraat 23, on the corner of Limoniastraat in Paramaribo, serving Surinamese dishes. Meals can be ordered by phone for takeaway or through the Fooddelivery and Ride-Eats apps.

name: Locacion Lounge & Bar
description: A bar and lounge on the Anamoestraat in Blauwgrond, opened in 2026. Drinks, grill food and an outdoor terrace in one of the busier nightlife streets north of the centre.

name: Loyals Caribbean
description: Loyals Caribbean is a marketing agency offering strategy and campaigns, online marketing, design and branding, and website development. It has offices in Willemstad on Curaçao, Oranjestad on Aruba and at Flustraat 31 in Paramaribo.

name: Lucky Store
description: Lucky Store is a department store at Jodenbreestraat 38-40 in Paramaribo selling household and kitchen appliances, kitchenware, electronics, furniture, home decor, school and office supplies, personal care products and clothing. The store also offers duty-free shopping and a loyalty card.

name: Lucky Twins Restaurant
description: Lucky Twins Restaurant is a Chinese-Surinamese eatery in Paramaribo with an extensive menu of Chinese dishes alongside classic Surinamese staples.

name: Luni Gifts
description: Luni Gifts is a drugstore and gift shop at Schietbaanweg 32 in Paramaribo, run by members of the Brazilian community. It sells beauty products and ready-made or custom gift sets, including Natura kits for men, women and children. Open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 to 18:00.

name: Luxatic motors
description: Luxatic motors is a car dealer at Ringweg Zuid 341 in Paramaribo selling used vehicles, including luxury models. The business focuses on making luxury cars affordable for buyers in Suriname.

name: Luxe Escape Lotus Spa Wellness Beautysalon
description: Luxe Escape Lotus Spa is a full-service spa and beauty salon in Paramaribo offering massages, facials, body treatments and beauty services in a luxurious, serene setting.

name: Luxe & Luminous Beauty Salon
description: Luxe & Luminous Beauty Salon is a beauty salon in Paramaribo run by a certified brow and lash stylist, offering eyebrow and eyelash treatments. The salon is located at Malebatrumstraat 1-5 in the HH Cabell building in central Paramaribo.

name: Surinat Luxury Resort
description: Four bungalows on the grounds of the old La Rencontre plantation in the village of Domburg, about thirty minutes from central Paramaribo. The resort has an outdoor pool, a jacuzzi, a wellness centre, a restaurant, wifi and free bicycles, with a shuttle to Zanderij airport.

name: Luxury Sky Resort
description: A public swimming pool and restaurant in Paramaribo, opened as the second pool of Luxury Sky Residence and open to non-residents.

name: Lybra Training, Coaching & Consulting N.V.
description: Lybra Training, Coaching & Consulting N.V. is a Paramaribo firm founded in 2011 that offers training, coaching and consulting with a focus on digital transformation and tailor-made programs. Its office is at Doloresstraat 33.

name: MAF Suriname
description: MAF Suriname is an independent Surinamese nonprofit organisation founded on 30 October 1964, based at Zorg en Hoop airport on Doekhieweg Oost 7 in Paramaribo.

name: Maharaja Palace
description: Maharaja Palace is an Indian restaurant in Paramaribo serving authentic North Indian cuisine including rich curries, tandoori dishes and freshly baked naan. A regal dining experience.

name: Malhoe Flooring
description: Malhoe Flooring sells floor and wall coverings such as laminate, wall panels, marble sheets, carpet, artificial grass and vinyl flooring at Kwattaweg 228 in Paramaribo.

name: Manglie's Rijstbedrijf
description: Manglie's Rijstbedrijf at Tourtonnelaan 83 in Paramaribo is the sales outlet of Rijstfabrieken Manglie N.V., a Surinamese rice producer with more than 60 years in rice farming and production.

name: Mantje Bigi Pan Tours
description: Mantje Bigi Pan Tours organises boat trips into the Bigi Pan nature reserve in Nickerie, offering day trips and overnight stays at Mantje's Lodge, a basic lodge on the lake reached by boat from the Mantje jetty. Activities include bird watching, spotting caimans, kayaking and mud baths.

name: Marchand Notariaat
description: Marchand Notariaat is a notarial practice in Suriname offering notarial services including property transfers, company formations, wills and official documentation.

name: Maretraite Hotel
description: A 14-room hotel on Haydnstraat at Maretraite 3 in Blauwgrond, about four kilometres from the Central Market and close to Maretraite Mall. Each room has a balcony, desk, flat-screen TV, private bathroom, safe, mini fridge and tea and coffee making. Free wifi and free private parking. No pets.

name: Marina Resort Waterland
description: Marina Resort Waterland is a riverside resort near Paramaribo offering boat docking, comfortable accommodation and waterfront dining. Popular with boating enthusiasts and families, it combines marina facilities with resort-style amenities.

name: Marinalex Resort & Waterpark
description: A creek-side resort and waterpark on the J.F. Kennedy Highway at Zanderij. Marinalex has bungalows, two-person rooms, pina huts and group accommodation, plus a large event hall and tall water slides, making it a common choice for family days out and parties.

name: Marowijne Resort
description: Marowijne Resort is a hotel and resort at Juliana Weyneweg 103 near Moengo in Marowijne, on the road between Moengo and Albina. It offers bedrooms for overnight stays, aimed at travellers driving between Albina and Paramaribo, with reservations made by WhatsApp.

name: Marsol N.V.
description: Marsol N.V. is a solar energy specialist on Nestorstraat in Paramaribo, installing solar water heaters for homes and businesses since 2000 and supplying off-grid solar packages.

name: Matcha Loft
description: Matcha Loft is a Japanese-inspired café in Paramaribo specialising in matcha drinks, bubble tea and Japanese-fusion light bites. A trendy destination for fans of Asian tea culture.

name: Matesa Tegels
description: Matesa Tegels is a tile specialist at Dr. Sophieredmondstraat 254 in Paramaribo, selling European tiles for floors, walls, bathrooms, kitchens and outdoor areas. The store also supplies renovation materials for home and building projects.

name: Mavi's Taxi
description: Mavi's Taxi is a travel and transport company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering airport transfers. Located at Abraham PH Samsonstraat 05.

name: Max N Co.
description: Max-N-Co is a women's clothing store at Johannes Mungrastraat 31 in Paramaribo, selling casual outfits as well as outfits for parties and weddings.

name: Maze
description: Maze is a multi-brand fashion store at Ringweg-Zuid 243 in Paramaribo, carrying sportswear, casual wear and international brands such as Mango, Guess, Aldo and Psycho Bunny.

name: McDonald's Centrum
description: McDonald's Centrum is the main central Paramaribo location of the global fast-food chain, serving burgers, fries, McNuggets and McCafé drinks. Open late, family-friendly and consistently busy. The standard McDonald's experience in central Paramaribo.

name: McDonald's Hermitage Mall
description: McDonald's Hermitage Mall is conveniently located in Paramaribo's Hermitage Mall, offering the full McDonald's menu in a comfortable food court setting.

name: MD Defence Shooting Academy
description: MD Defence Shooting Academy in Paramaribo runs shooting courses taught by a certified instructor with over 30 years of experience and guides clients step by step through applying for a firearm licence.

name: Measuresolutions
description: Measuresolutions is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering legal services, property sales and rentals and construction. Located at Wagenwegstraat 37.

name: Meat At Midnight Caribbean Bar & Grill
description: A Caribbean bar and grill on the Grote Combeweg, a short walk from the Palmentuin. Grilled meats and Caribbean plates, open into the evening.

name: Medische Zending Primary Health Care Suriname
description: Provides primary health care to the interior, running clinics in villages along the rivers where no other medical services exist.

name: Meindertsma Suriname N.V.
description: Meindertsma Suriname N.V., founded in 1970, imports heavy equipment and components, tools, bearings, seals and belts, and is the official DEVELON dealer in Suriname. It is based at Industrieweg Noord 58 in Paramaribo.

name: Mel-An-Gi Hair
description: Mel-An-Gi Hair is a women's and men's hair salon with more than 20 years of experience, located at Albert B. Prinsstraat 25 in Surivillage, Paramaribo.

name: Meliaz Firm
description: Meliaz Firm is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering legal services, property sales and rentals and construction. Located at Van Idsigastraat 42.

name: Melilew Boutique Hotel
description: A bed and breakfast in the middle of Paramaribo on Henck Arronstraat, five minutes on foot from the Saints Peter and Paul cathedral and ten from Independence Square. Rooms range from doubles to family quads and studio suites, all air conditioned with free wifi. There is an outdoor pool with a separate children's pool, free parking and a 24-hour desk.

name: Menimi Eco Resort
description: A family-run eco resort on an island by the Djemongo rapids in the Upper Suriname River, about an hour upstream by boat from Atjoni. The waterfront cottages were designed and built by the Saramaccan owner, and activities include village tours to Guyaba and New Aurora, night trips to spot caiman, and visits to the Felulasi rapids. Menimi means remember me in Saramaccan.

name: Messias Tours
description: Messias Tours is a Surinamese tour operator offering guided excursions including jungle adventures, river trips and cultural tours. Known for professional guiding and customised itineraries.

name: Metalock Suriname NV
description: Metalock Suriname NV is a metalworking business on Wakibasoestraat in Paramaribo.

name: METS Travel & Tours
description: Suriname's longest-running tour operator, founded in 1962 and focused on sustainable travel. METS runs its own jungle lodges at Palumeu and Awarradam and the Cola Creek recreation resort in the savannah belt, alongside tailor-made trips. There is a sales office on Dr. J.F. Nassylaan in the centre.
address: Doekhieweg Oost 1, Zorg en Hoop, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Mezze Suriname
description: Mezze Suriname is a Mediterranean and Middle Eastern restaurant in Paramaribo serving shared small plates, grilled meats, hummus and dips. A social dining experience celebrating Levantine food culture.

name: Mgr. Aloysius Zichem Sportcentrum (AZS)
description: Mgr. Aloysius Zichem Sportcentrum (AZS) is a football stadium on Prins Hendrikstraat in Paramaribo with a grass pitch and room for about 3,000 spectators. Opened in 1961 as the NGVB Stadion, it is owned by Paramaribo and operated by the Nieuwe Generatie Voetbal Bond.

name: Mi Gudu River Cruiser
description: Mi Gudu River Cruiser is a 28-metre saloon boat for up to 130 guests, offering Sunday sunset cruises, Commewijne River cruises past old plantations and private charters for weddings, parties and business trips. Its office is at Prinsessestraat 37 in Paramaribo.

name: MICHI Natural Foods N.V.
description: MICHI Natural Foods N.V. is a Surinamese food manufacturer at Michilaan 5 in Paramaribo, making natural food and drink products from local produce such as ambarella.

name: Micki's Palace Noord
description: Micki's Palace Noord, on Hecubastraat in north Paramaribo, is a branch of the Micki's Palace fast-food restaurant, known for cheesy fries, pastas, burgers and hot wings, with cocktail nights on Fridays and Saturdays.

name: Micki's Palace Zuid
description: Micki's Palace Zuid is the south Paramaribo branch of Micki's Palace, a fast-food restaurant specialising in cheesy fries, pastas, patat shoarma, hot wings and burgers.

name: MidasSur Aviation
description: MidasSur Aviation is a Paramaribo-based aviation management company founded in 2021, offering travel and cargo services, including flights linking New York, Paramaribo and Georgetown.

name: Mighty Racks
description: Mighty Racks is a BBQ restaurant in Paramaribo specialising in slow-smoked ribs, pulled meats and classic American-style sides. The wood-fired pits and generous portions have made it a firm favourite among meat lovers in Suriname. Great for a filling dinner or a proper weekend feast.

name: Mike's Autoparts Accessories & Repair
description: Mike's Autoparts Accessories & Repair is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, spare parts and repairs. Located at Kwattaweg #316.

name: Millie's Resort
description: Millie's Resort is a family-friendly recreation resort at Hercus Leonel Lingerweg 76 in Republiek, Para, on the former Plantage Vierkinderen along the Tawayakoera creek. It offers a quiet setting for local visitors looking to relax.

name: Mimi Market
description: Mimi Market is a neighbourhood grocery store in Paramaribo offering fresh products, pantry essentials and daily needs at accessible prices.

name: Minequip Suriname
description: Minequip Suriname is an industrial and energy company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering maintenance, mining services and wholesale distribution. Located at Industrieweg Noord Nr 31.

name: Mines Services Suriname N.V
description: Mines Services Suriname N.V. supplies industrial goods and services from Sir Winston Churchillweg 5 in Paramaribo, including lifting equipment, inspection and certification, and is a LEEA-certified maker of wire rope, chain and polyester slings.

name: Ming Kee Autoparts & Accessories
description: Ming Kee Autoparts & Accessories is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, spare parts and repairs. Located at Tourtonnelaan 122-124.
address: Tourtonnelaan 122-124, Professor W.J. Kernkampweg 29, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Mingle Paramaribo
description: Mingle Paramaribo is a cocktail lounge in the city with a well-stocked bar and upscale interior design. The menu covers classic and contemporary cocktails. Popular for after-work drinks and evening gatherings, it draws a crowd looking for a polished bar experience in Paramaribo.

name: Mingle Sushi
description: Mingle Sushi is the dedicated sushi counter within the Mingle Paramaribo concept, offering fresh-rolled sushi, poke bowls and Japanese-inspired dishes.

name: Mini Nail Shop
description: Mini Nail Shop is a nail salon in Paramaribo offering manicures, pedicures, nail art and gel nails. A popular spot for affordable, quality nail care services.

name: Miniso Gompertstraat
description: Miniso on Gompertstraat is a branch of the popular Japanese lifestyle brand, offering affordable design-led products including stationery, beauty, toys and homeware.

name: Miniso Hermitage Mall
description: Miniso at Hermitage Mall brings the popular Japanese lifestyle brand's full range of affordable, design-led products to Paramaribo's premier shopping centre.

name: Mirage Casino
description: Mirage Casino is a casino at Domineestraat 11 in central Paramaribo, part of the Mirage Hotel & Casino. It offers about 20 live gaming tables, including blackjack, roulette and poker games, around 300 slot machines and VIP gaming facilities.

name: Mirosso
description: Mirosso serves Javanese-Surinamese cooking in Blauwgrond, the district best known for its Indonesian kitchens. A neighbourhood restaurant with a long track record among visitors.

name: Misabi Testmanagement n.v.
description: Misabi Testmanagement n.v. is a technology and media company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering software development and testing and certification. Located at Prof Kernkampweg 4 – unit 6.

name: Miss Doll Fit
description: Miss Doll Fit is a pole fitness studio at Verlengde Gemenelandsweg 164 in Paramaribo. It offers pole dance, strength training and flexibility classes for people of different ages and levels.

name: MJ Lounge & Club
description: MJ Lounge & Club is a nightclub and lounge at Hofstraat 111 in the centre of Paramaribo. It opened in December 2024 under the name MJ Millionaire Club & Lounge and has a modern interior with DJ nights.

name: MK's Gym Suriname
description: MK's Gym Suriname is a fitness and wellness centre in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering gym facilities. Located at Normandie Straat 65.

name: M&N Car Center
description: M&N Car Center is a car dealership at Belladonnastraat 1, on the corner of Kwattaweg in Paramaribo, selling new and used cars imported from Japan and the United States. It also offers vehicle financing, trade-ins and electric vehicle options.

name: MN International Centrum
description: MN International Centrum is the city centre branch of MN International N.V., a Surinamese retail company selling electronics, furniture and home goods. The company is listed at Henck Arronstraat 186 in Paramaribo.

name: MN International Kwatta
description: MN International Kwatta is a branch of the Surinamese retail and trading company, serving the Kwatta district with a range of consumer goods.

name: MNS Notarissen
description: MNS Notarissen is a civil-law notary office at Prins Hendrikstraat 6 in Paramaribo, where notaries Maureen Pinas, Nandini Lalaram and Shavita Mahadewsing practise. The office is listed by the Surinaamse Notariële Beroepsorganisatie (SNB), the professional association of notaries in Suriname.

name: Mobile King
description: A phone shop at Meerzorg on the Oost-West Verbinding, selling handsets and accessories and handling repairs and unlocking. One of the larger mobile retailers east of the Suriname river.

name: Moboco N.V.
description: Moboco N.V. has supplied nuts, bolts, fasteners and tools since 1977, serving sectors such as oil from Industrieweg Noord in Paramaribo.

name: MoGlow Pilates Studio
description: MoGlow Pilates Studio is a boutique Pilates studio in Paramaribo with locations in the north and south of the city, offering 50-minute workouts that focus on strengthening and balancing the body.
address: Twee kinderenweg 69, L’Hermitageweg 132, Corner Emielaan, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Moka Coffeebar
description: Moka Coffee Bar is a speciality coffee shop in Paramaribo focused on quality espresso and filter brews, serving artisan coffee alongside homemade pastries.

name: Mokisa Busidataa Osu N.V.
description: Mokisa Busidataa Osu N.V., trading as Mokisa Wellness, is a wellness clinic on Dr. Sophie Redmondstraat in Paramaribo offering treatments and products based on traditional Maroon healing.

name: Mokisa Wellness
description: Mokisa Wellness is a wellness centre on Dr. Sophie Redmondstraat in Paramaribo offering treatments and products based on traditional Maroon healing practices.

name: Moment's Restaurant
description: Moment's Restaurant is the main dining venue at Oxygen Resort in Paramaribo, set within the resort's garden surroundings. The menu combines international dishes with local Surinamese cuisine, using locally sourced and organic produce where available. Open to both resort guests and walk-in diners.

name: MoMo Korean Fried Chicken
description: MoMo Korean Fried Chicken is a restaurant in Paramaribo serving Korean-style fried chicken with its own sauces. It has a location on Zinniastraat and a second branch, MoMo Nieuwweer, at Nieuw Weergevondenweg 229.

name: Mon Plaisir Nursery
description: Mon Plaisir Nursery is a plant nursery in Suriname carrying a wide variety of tropical and ornamental plants suited to Surinamese gardens, balconies and interiors. A calm, green spot to browse and pick up plants, pots and garden essentials.

name: Monarch Furnishings and Sofa
description: Monarch Furnishings and Sofa is a furniture store at Rahemalweg 16-18 in Wanica, selling furniture, upholstery fabrics and faux leather.

name: Mondowa Tours
description: Mondowa Tours is a reputable Surinamese tour operator offering eco-tours, jungle expeditions and cultural experiences. Specialising in sustainable tourism into Suriname's pristine interior.

name: Morevans Outlet
description: Morevans Outlet is a furniture and home goods discount store in Paramaribo carrying sofas, dining sets, bedroom furniture and accent pieces at outlet prices. A practical stop for anyone furnishing a home or looking for branded furniture without the full retail price tag.

name: Morgaine Beauty
description: Morgaine Beauty is a beauty salon and cosmetics brand in Suriname offering beauty services alongside its own makeup products.

name: M&S Trading
description: M&S Trading is a building materials supplier in Wanica, Suriname, offering construction, import and trading. Located at Martin Lutherkingweg 33.

name: MSC Suriname N.V.
description: MSC Suriname N.V. is the Suriname office of Mediterranean Shipping Company, active in Paramaribo since 2013 and handling container cargo to and from Suriname. It is located at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 9-11.
address: Van 't Hogerhuys St 9-11, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: MTC Resort
description: A sports and recreation resort on Grankreekweg at Rijsdijk in Para, about forty kilometres south of Paramaribo and established in 2017. It has a 25-metre pool and a children's pool, a 21-obstacle course, a beach volleyball court, a 1.6 km motocross track, and fifteen shooting bays used for IPSC and clay pigeon shooting.

name: Multi Travel
description: Multi Travel is a full-service travel agency in Paramaribo offering flight tickets, hotel bookings, tour packages and travel insurance. Experienced in both leisure and corporate travel.

name: Muntjes Take Out Juniors Place
description: Muntjes Take-Out / Junior's Place is a local Surinamese take-out restaurant offering quick, affordable meals and snacks for the on-the-go crowd.

name: Murphys Irish Pub
description: Murphy's Irish Pub is Paramaribo's authentic Irish-themed pub, offering Guinness and Irish beers, classic pub food and live sports. A gathering place for expats and football fans in Suriname.

name: Museum Bakkie
description: Museum Bakkie is a unique plantation heritage museum on former coffee plantation Reynsdorp in Commewijne. Set in a beautifully restored colonial building, it offers intimate exhibits on plantation life and Surinamese history.

name: My Bakery
description: My Bakery is a bakery at Gompertstraat 66 in the north of Paramaribo that makes cakes and other sweet treats to order. Orders can be placed by phone, WhatsApp or email.

name: Myrysji Tours Suriname
description: Myrysji Tours Suriname is a Paramaribo-based tour operator focused on trips to Galibi in Marowijne, where it runs the Myrysji Lodge and offers sea turtle watching, village walks, kayaking and mud bath tours. It also arranges trips to Awarradam, Danpaati River Lodge, the Commewijne plantations and St. Laurent du Maroni in French Guiana.

name: N. V. Thuk
description: N.V. Thuk is a security company founded in 2000, offering guarding, object security and cash and valuables transport, with offices in Paramaribo and Nickerie.

name: Nakaso Auto & Parts Sales
description: Nakaso Auto & Parts Sales is a car dealership selling vehicles and parts at the corner of Washingtonstraat and New Yorkstraat in Paramaribo.
address: Washingtonstraat hoek New Yorkstraat , Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Namidi N.V.
description: Namidi N.V. is an IT company on Kasjoemastraat in Paramaribo that builds websites, webshops and software and provides IT consultancy.

name: Naskip Henck Arronstraat
description: Naskip Henck Arronstraat is a branch of Naskip, the Surinamese fried chicken specialist founded in 1962, serving fried chicken, wings, fries, corn and lemonade on Henck Arronstraat in Paramaribo.

name: Naskip Latourweg
description: Naskip Latourweg is a branch of Naskip, the Surinamese fried chicken specialist founded in 1962, serving fried chicken, wings, fries, corn and lemonade at Latourweg 10 in Paramaribo.

name: Naskip Gemenelandsweg
description: Naskip Gemenelandsweg is a branch of Naskip, the Surinamese fried chicken specialist founded in 1962, serving fried chicken, wings, fries, corn and lemonade on Verlengde Gemenelandsweg in Paramaribo.

name: Naskip Kwatta
description: Naskip Kwatta is a branch of Naskip, the Surinamese fried chicken specialist founded in 1962, serving fried chicken, wings, fries, corn and lemonade at the corner of Kwattaweg and Van Idsingastraat in Paramaribo.

name: Naskip Indira Ghandiweg
description: Naskip Indira Ghandiweg is a branch of Naskip, the Surinamese fried chicken specialist founded in 1962, serving fried chicken, wings, fries, corn and lemonade at the corner of Indira Ghandiweg and Schotelweg in Wanica.

name: Nassy Brouwer College
description: Nassy-Brouwer College is a secondary school in Paramaribo providing academic education at HAVO and VWO level. Part of Suriname's Dutch-curriculum school system, preparing students for local and international higher education.

name: Nassy Brouwer School
description: Nassy Brouwer School is a private primary school at Joli Coeurstraat 6 in Paramaribo North, with kindergarten and primary groups following the curriculum of the Ministry of Education. It grew out of a kindergarten opened in 1891, and its sister school, the Nassy Brouwer College, has offered VWO secondary education since 2018.

name: Nationaal Vervoer Bedrijf
description: Nationaal Vervoer Bedrijf (NVB) is Suriname's state bus company, founded in 1997 from the former Staatsbusdienst. From its base at Heiligenweg 10 in Paramaribo it runs scheduled bus services in the city and to the districts, and publishes departure times from the Heiligenweg bus station.

name: Nationale Ontwikkelingsbank (NOB)
description: The Nationale Ontwikkelingsbank van Suriname N.V. (NOB) is Suriname's only development bank, state-owned and active for about 60 years, with its office at Mr. Jagernath Lachmonstraat 160-162 in Paramaribo.
address: Jaggernath Lachmon St,160-162, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Naughty Angel Beauty Salon
description: Naughty Angel Beauty Salon is a beauty salon at Oost-West Verbinding 603 in Tamanredjo, in the Commewijne district, offering hair removal and pedicure treatments. Appointments can be made by phone or email.

name: Nazubs Suites
description: Nazubs Suites rents self-catering apartments on Leysweg in southern Paramaribo. Full kitchens and quiet residential surroundings make it a fit for families and longer stays.

name: Neotropical Butterfly Park
description: A butterfly park at Lelydorp, 30 to 45 minutes from Paramaribo, holding over 150 species. The breeding operation was started by Ewout and Amira Eriks in 1996 and opened to visitors around 2010. Tours follow the full cycle from egg through larva and cocoon to butterfly, and the site also has a gallery of native flora and fauna, a hand-painted 360-degree panorama of Surinamese landscapes upstairs, and a small cafe serving cold drinks and local snacks.

name: Nesotec NV
description: Nesotec NV is a technology and media company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering hardware, software development and network services. Located at Madeliefjestraat 21.

name: Netlink Communications NV
description: Netlink Communications N.V. is an ICT and network company at Hermesstraat 43 in Paramaribo, providing connectivity and network services to businesses. The office is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00. See netlinknv.com.

name: Nettech NV
description: Nettech NV has provided integrated ICT services in Suriname since 1995 from its office at Kwattaweg 296 in Paramaribo. Its services include network cabling, servers, IP telephony and security cameras, secure networks and VPNs, software and ERP systems, and helpdesk support.

name: NetWave NV
description: NetWave NV is a telecommunications and data technology company on Lalla Rookhweg in Paramaribo, supporting organisations with telecom and data solutions.

name: New Choice Lalla Rookhweg
description: New Choice Lalla Rookhweg is a branch of New Choice, a Surinamese fashion and sportswear store chain selling the latest styles at affordable prices, located at Lalla Rookhweg 54 in Paramaribo.

name: New Choice Nickerie
description: New Choice Nickerie is a branch of New Choice, a Surinamese fashion and sportswear store chain selling the latest styles at affordable prices, located at Emmastraat 2 in Nieuw Nickerie.

name: New Choice Ringweg
description: New Choice Ringweg is a branch of New Choice, a Surinamese fashion and sportswear store chain selling the latest styles at affordable prices, located at Ringweg-Zuid 189A in Paramaribo.

name: New Suriname Dream Cafe
description: New Suriname Dream Café is a modern café in Paramaribo offering a relaxed setting for coffees, light meals and social gatherings. Serving both local and international dishes.

name: Newmont Suriname
description: Operator of the Merian gold mine in the east of the country, one of Suriname's largest foreign investments and a significant employer.

name: Newtech Rainville
description: Newtech supplies and installs air conditioning and refrigeration, plus garage doors, gates and power tools. This is the Rainville branch on the Hofstede Crullaan.

name: Newtech Zwartenhovenbrugstraat
description: Newtech Zwartenhovenbrugstraat is the branch of New Tech N.V. at Zwartenhovenbrugstraat 246 in Paramaribo, offering sales, installation and maintenance of air conditioning, ventilation and refrigeration systems. The company is a dealer for brands such as Carrier, Toshiba and Danfoss and also installs generators and garage doors.

name: Next Club Suriname
description: Next Club Suriname is a nightclub inside the Ramada Paramaribo Princess hotel at Kleine Waterstraat 9 in central Paramaribo, with local and international DJs. Hotel guests get free entry on regular club nights.

name: Ni-Ké Meubel en interieur accessoires
description: Ni-Ké Meubel en Interieur Accessoires is the BLUM representative in Suriname, giving expert advice on kitchens, bathrooms and walk-in closets, with a showroom in Paramaribo and an online shop.

name: Niamat Rental
description: Niamat Rental is a party and event rental company on the Tweederijweg in Paramaribo, supplying tents, tables, chairs and other event equipment.

name: Nickerie Tennis Club
description: Nickerie Tennis Club is a tennis club at Skrifimankotiestraat 1 in Nieuw Nickerie, founded on 1 March 1939 to promote the sport in the district. It caters to recreational and competitive players, gives tennis lessons and hosts local tournaments.

name: Night Club Diamond
description: A nightclub on Anton Dragtenweg with resident DJs and live performances, drawing a young crowd. There is a bar and restaurant attached.

name: Nirvana Business Hotel
description: A ten-room business hotel on Keizerstraat, just off Princess Casino and around a kilometre from the centre. Rooms have a seating area, writing desk, microwave, kettle and kitchenware, with free wifi throughout and free private parking. The Central Market and Waterkant are both close by.

name: Nishika Enterprise N.V
description: Nishika Enterprise N.V is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales and import. Located at Franchepanestraat 140.

description: Peperpot Nature Park in Commewijne is a former plantation transformed into a birding paradise just 10 minutes from Paramaribo by ferry. Over 200 species have been recorded in this accessible natural sanctuary.
address: Hadji Iding Soemitaweg 32, Nieuw Meerzorg, Commewijne, Suriname

name: Percy Massage Therapy
description: Percy Massage Therapy is a professional massage therapy practice in Paramaribo offering therapeutic and relaxation massages for stress relief and muscle recovery.

name: Perfect Car's
description: Perfect Car's is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, property valuation and import. Located at Ringweg noord #68.

name: Petisco Restaurant
description: Petisco Restaurant is a Portuguese and Brazilian-inspired tapas restaurant in Paramaribo offering small plates, grilled meats and a lively social atmosphere.

name: Petit Bouchon
description: Petit Bouchon is a French café on the first floor at Kleine Waterstraat 1 in Paramaribo, serving freshly baked croissants, pastries and bread, with brunch classics at weekends.

name: Phenox Consultants
description: Phenox Consultants advises on pensions and employee benefits from its office at Mr. F.H.R. Lim A Postraat 18 in Paramaribo, which also houses the Suralco Pension Desk.
address: Mr. F.H.R Lim A Postraat #18, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Philipson Trading
description: Philipson Trading is a store at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 35 in Paramaribo selling car batteries and outboard motors. It is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:30 and Saturday from 08:00 to 15:00, closed on Sundays and public holidays. Contact +597 402-298.

name: Pineapple Tours
description: Pineapple Tours is a Paramaribo-based tour operator offering a range of Surinamese experiences from city tours and plantation visits to jungle and river adventures.

name: Pinkmoon Suriname
description: Pinkmoon Suriname is a wellness and beauty studio in Paramaribo offering massages, facials, body treatments and wellness sessions. The focus is on relaxation and self-care rather than clinical procedures, with treatments suited to both drop-in visitors and regular clients.

name: Pitbull Fitness
description: Pitbull Fitness is a high-energy gym in Paramaribo offering intensive training, bodybuilding equipment and group fitness sessions. Popular with serious athletes and fitness enthusiasts.

name: Pizza Hut Leysweg
description: Pizza Hut Leysweg is a branch of the international pizza chain in Paramaribo, serving pan pizzas, pasta and sides with dine-in, takeaway and delivery.

name: Pizza Hut South
description: Pizza Hut South delivers classic pizzas, stuffed crusts and chicken to the southern Paramaribo area with dine-in and delivery options.

name: Pizza Hut Wilhelminastraat
description: Pizza Hut Wilhelminastraat is centrally located on one of Paramaribo's main commercial streets, offering the full Pizza Hut menu for city-centre shoppers.

name: Pizza Mafia
description: Pizza Mafia is a local Surinamese pizzeria known for generously loaded pizzas at great value. Popular for bold flavour combinations and reliable delivery across Paramaribo.

name: Places2Go Suriname
description: Places2Go Suriname is a tour organisation on the Kwasibastraat in Paramaribo, founded by Elman Apinsa, that runs day trips, multi-day tours and round trips in almost every district of Suriname. It works on a community-based model with local guides, cooks and villages, and also offers taxi transfers and sports events.

name: Planet Casino Suriname
description: Planet Casino Suriname is a slot machine casino at Kwattaweg 596 in Paramaribo, operated by the Senator group. Senator entered the Surinamese market in 2018 with its first casino in Paramaribo and has since also opened a casino at the Royal Breeze Hotel.

name: Plantage Frederiksdorp
description: Plantage Frederiksdorp is a plantation resort on the Commewijne River combining a small museum, a slavery heritage trail and riverfront accommodation. Reached by boat from Paramaribo, the site is one of the best-preserved plantation estates in Suriname and worth the trip for anyone interested in the country's colonial history.

name: Platinum Quality Cars NV
description: Platinum Quality Cars NV is a car dealership at Toevluchtweg 63 in Paramaribo that buys and sells new and second-hand cars.

name: Point Plaza Centrum
description: Point Plaza is a Surinamese department store that gathers household goods, electronics, clothing and toys under one roof. This is the Centrum branch on the Hermand D. Benjaminstraat.

name: Point Plaza Noord
description: The Point Plaza branch on the Saturnusstraat in Paramaribo Noord, stocking household goods, electronics, clothing and toys.

name: Point Plaza Tammenga
description: The Point Plaza store on the Leysweg at Tammenga, the largest of the chain's Paramaribo locations.

name: Popeyes Centrum
description: Popeyes Centrum is the central Paramaribo branch of the Louisiana-inspired fried chicken chain, serving crispy chicken sandwiches, tenders and sides.

name: Popeyes Lelydorp
description: Popeyes Lelydorp is the Lelydorp branch of Popeyes, the international fast food chain, in the Wanica district. It serves New Orleans-style fried chicken, including spicy chicken and chicken tenders, along with sides and other items from the Popeyes menu.

name: Popeyes TBL
description: Popeyes TBL is a Paramaribo branch of Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, the fast-food chain known for fried chicken and Cajun-style sides. Popeyes Suriname also has branches on Domineestraat, Wilhelminastraat and in Lelydorp, and offers online ordering and late-night deals.

name: Popeyes Wilhelminastraat
description: Popeyes Wilhelminastraat is a central Paramaribo location of the globally recognised fried chicken brand on one of the city's busiest shopping streets.

name: Pot Cova Restaurant
description: Pot Cova is a Jamaican restaurant on the Wagenweg in Paramaribo, cooking under the motto “Yaad A’broad, Pot Fulla Flava”. Expect island classics such as curry chicken alongside tropical drinks, with a relaxed, reggae-flavoured atmosphere. Group and birthday packages are available with advance reservation.

name: Powerful Automotive
description: Powerful Automotive is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, customs clearance and property valuation. Located at Kwattaweg 350.

name: Praia Branca
description: Een prachtig privéterrein buiten de stad; de ideale, rustgevende plek om heerlijk te ontspannen. De woning ligt aan een kreek en beschikt over kamers met airconditioning, een badkamer met warm en koud water, en kookgelegenheid. Er is comfortabele slaapgelegenheid voor maximaal 16 personen.

name: Preconsu Construction and Environmental Services N.V
description: Preconsu Construction and Environmental Services N.V is a construction and engineering company based in Paramaribo, Suriname. Located at JaggernathLachmonstreet #62.

name: Prico's Machineshop
description: Prico's Machineshop, founded in 1984, is an industrial machine shop at Kwattaweg 695 in Paramaribo, doing lathe work and the pressing in and out of parts for the industrial sector.

name: Printwise Imprint Solutions
description: Printwise Imprint Solutions, launched in March 2004, is a printing and imprint company at Heliconstraat 34 in Paramaribo, producing printed products for business customers.

name: Pristine Car NV
description: Pristine Car NV is the official Hyundai dealer in Suriname, selling models such as the Hyundai Tucson and Santa Fe from Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 23 in Paramaribo.
address: Van 't Hogerhuys St 23, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Pristine Rainforest Tours
description: A travel agency building trips around Suriname's rainforest interior, with jungle walks and hikes, river boating, wildlife and bird spotting, mountain climbing, swimming in rapids and kayaking. Also runs multi-country itineraries across the three Guianas.

name: Pro-Fitness Nickerie
description: Pro-Fitness Nickerie is a fitness centre at Awinistraat 40 in Nieuw Nickerie, operating under the slogan Get Fit For Life. The gym describes itself as a professional fitness centre offering a full range of fitness activities for its members.

name: ProCallcenter Suriname
description: ProCallcenter Suriname runs a Dutch-speaking contact centre at Keizerstraat 71 in Paramaribo, handling outsourced customer service, back-office work and ICT support for its clients.

description: Prodimex International, founded in 1973, is an office supplies wholesaler and retailer at J.A. Pengelstraat 175 in Paramaribo, offering more than 8,000 office products and complete office solutions, also online.

name: Professional Private Security
description: Professional Private Security is a Surinamese security services provider offering trained security personnel, access control and surveillance solutions for businesses and events.

name: Proplan Vastgoed
description: Proplan Vastgoed (Proplan Real Estate N.V.) is a real estate developer and broker active in both Suriname and the Netherlands, with more than 250 new-build homes co-developed over the past years. The company develops gated communities such as Crown Park at Leiding 9A and Coco Village at Leiding 10, just south of Paramaribo. Services cover buying, selling and renting homes and land, professional property management, renovation projects, guidance on estates and inheritances, and personal training on investing in real estate. Dutch and English spoken, office at the International Mall of Suriname at Ringweg-Zuid in Paramaribo.
address: International Mall of Suriname, Ringweg-Zuid 245 - Unit H2, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Protrade International
description: Protrade International NV is a Surinamese store on Kwattaweg in Paramaribo selling ready-to-assemble furniture, kitchen appliances and home products, with delivery available.

name: PSC CONTRACTING GROUP N.V.
description: PSC CONTRACTING GROUP N.V. is a construction and engineering company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering cleaning services.

name: PTC University of Applied Sciences
description: PTC University of Applied Sciences (Polytechnic College Suriname) offers higher professional education programmes, including food technology, from Slangenhoutstraat 99a in Saron, Paramaribo.

name: Purity Tours & Services
description: Purity Tours & Services is a SHATA-member tour operator on Heerenstraat, offering guided excursions with qualified guides plus car and bicycle rental.

name: Q-Inn Boutique Hotel Paramaribo
description: A boutique hotel on Costerstraat, under two kilometres from the Central Market and about a kilometre from the Saints Peter and Paul cathedral. Rooms have flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms, a laptop safe and a hairdryer. There is a bar with a terrace, a buffet breakfast, free wifi, free private parking, and bike and car hire on site.

name: QSI International School Of Suriname
description: QSI International School of Suriname is an accredited international school in Paramaribo offering the American curriculum from preschool through high school. Serving the expatriate and Surinamese community with a globally recognised education.

name: Quality Tiles Suriname N.V.
description: Quality Tiles Suriname N.V. is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tiles, sanitary ware and construction. Located at Duisburglaan.

name: Qualogy Caribbean n.v.
description: Qualogy Caribbean is the Suriname branch of IT consultancy Qualogy, offering nearshore software development, IT staffing and software testing from Paramaribo.

name: Queens Hotel
description: A hotel on Kleine Waterstraat, in the middle of Paramaribo's entertainment district and within walking distance of the historic centre. Queens has held ISO 9001 quality certification since 2022.

name: Quickship Logistics
description: QuickShip Logistics is a cargo and freight company at Nadiastraat 19 in Paramaribo, shipping packages and goods from Miami to Paramaribo. Customers track shipments through quickship.sr. Contact +597 863-7214.

name: R Durga & Sons NV
description: R. Durga & Sons N.V. is a woodworking company on Sir Winston Churchillweg in Paramaribo producing Ipé flooring, decking, stairs and hardwood construction materials, also for export.
address: Sir Winston Churchillweg no. 73 , Paramaribo, Suriname

name: R K Bisdom Paramaribo
description: R.K. Bisdom Paramaribo is the Roman Catholic Diocese of Paramaribo, the central institution of the Catholic Church in Suriname, providing pastoral, educational and social services.

name: Rachel's Apartments
description: Rachel's Apartments provides serviced apartments on Sipaliwinilaan in Paramaribo, a long-established option for visitors who want more space than a hotel room.

description: Radiologie Kliniek Halfhide is a radiology clinic at Abraham Samsonstraat 18 in Paramaribo offering diagnostic imaging. Its examinations include ultrasound, CT scans including cardiac CT and calcium scoring, MRI scans, mammography and X-rays.

name: Radisson Hotel Paramaribo
description: Radisson Hotel Paramaribo is the city's flagship international luxury hotel, offering spacious rooms, rooftop pool with river views, multiple dining outlets, a spa and extensive meeting facilities. The preferred choice for business travellers and executives visiting Suriname.

name: Raja Ji
description: Raja Ji is an Indian restaurant in Paramaribo serving traditional South Asian dishes including curries, biryanis and tandoori specialities. A popular destination for Indian cuisine lovers.

name: Rajhar Insurance Consultancy
description: Rajhar Insurance Consultancy is an insurance consultancy at Hendrikstraat 170 in the Welgelegen area of Paramaribo. It arranges motor third-party liability and comprehensive car insurance, fire insurance and life insurance, among other types of cover.

name: Ramada Paramaribo Princess
description: Ramada by Wyndham Paramaribo Princess is an upscale city hotel featuring well-appointed rooms, a rooftop pool, casino, restaurant and business centre. Part of the international Wyndham portfolio, it delivers international hotel standards in Paramaribo.

name: Ramasre Cars & Parts

description: Ramdat Import Agencies is a professional services firm in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering import. Located at Mangolaan 76.

description: Ramons Car Center, also written Ramon's Car Center, is a vehicle dealer at Indira Gandhiweg 192 in Lelydorp, in the Wanica district. It sells passenger cars, buses and mopeds, which the business describes as being in A1 condition.

description: Randoe Meubelen is one of Suriname's established furniture retailers, carrying living room, bedroom and office furniture. Known for quality products and competitive pricing compared to the larger chains, with a loyal local customer base.

description: Rapid Import Export NV is a logistics company founded in 2009 that provides customs clearance, air and sea freight, freight forwarding, online shopping services and wholesale distribution. Its head office, Rapid Noord, is at Zinkstraat 13 in Paramaribo, with a second branch, Rapid Zuid, at Nadiastraat 43.

name: Rasonic Televisie en Radio Suriname
description: Rasonic Televisie en Radio Suriname is a broadcaster based in the Nickerie district whose services include the radio station Rasonic Radio 105.3 FM. The media house covers Nickerie and also reaches audiences in Paramaribo.

name: Rasonic Travel
description: A travel agency in Paramaribo, part of the Rasonic group. Not to be confused with Rasonic Televisie en Radio, which is a separate business in Nickerie.

name: Raytje's Kukru
description: Raytje's Kukru is a food business in Paramaribo serving Surinamese dishes, which it promotes through a Facebook page with several thousand followers. The name comes from Sranan Tongo, in which kukru means kitchen.

name: RBL STROOP
description: RBL Stroop is een Surinaams merk dat heerlijke, geconcentreerde essencesiropen maakt die je eenvoudig met water aanlengt tot een verfrissende drank. Met verschillende smaakvolle varianten, van klassiek fruitig tot zoet en vertrouwd, biedt RBL Stroop een lekkere drank voor elk moment.

name: RCR Medical Centre
description: RCR Medical Centre is a private medical centre at Anton Dragtenweg 68 in Paramaribo, staffed by specialists and nurses from the Netherlands and Suriname and working to European care standards. It offers gynaecology, a birth centre, internal medicine, urology and a GP post, as well as a care hotel and nursing home.

name: Re Max Suriname
description: RE/MAX Suriname is the local franchise of the world's largest real estate network, offering professional property sales, rentals and investment advisory services across Suriname.

name: Readytex Art Gallery
description: Readytex Art Gallery is Suriname's leading contemporary art gallery, representing local and Caribbean artists. Located in Paramaribo, it showcases paintings, sculpture and mixed-media works that reflect Suriname's diverse cultural heritage.

name: Readytex Souvenirs and Crafts
description: Readytex Souvenirs and Crafts is a well-established Surinamese arts and crafts retailer in Paramaribo, founded in 1984. Stocks original artwork, textiles, locally made jewellery, carvings and Surinamese cultural souvenirs. One of the best places in Paramaribo to buy quality local crafts.

name: Real One Fitness Gym
description: Real One Fitness Gym is a Paramaribo gym offering strength training, cardio and group fitness classes. Known for an encouraging atmosphere and experienced coaching staff.

name: Recreatie Oord Carolina Kreek
description: Recreatie Oord Carolina Kreek is a nature recreation area outside Paramaribo built around a natural creek. The site offers swimming, picnic areas and access to the surrounding forest in a quiet setting away from the city. A popular day-trip destination for families and groups from Paramaribo.

name: Recreatieoord Tropic Resort
description: A private recreation ground on Palisadeweg near Lelydorp, about 30 km from Paramaribo, hired out to one group at a time for gatherings and day use.

name: Red Century Party Shop Commewijne
description: Red Century Party Shop Commewijne is the district's go-to store for party supplies, decorations, balloons, tableware and event materials. Covers birthdays, baby showers and community celebrations.

name: Red Century Party Shop Kwatta
description: Red Century Party Shop Kwatta serves the Kwatta area with a full range of party supplies including balloons, banners, themed tableware and event decorations. Competitively priced and well-stocked for birthdays, graduations and all kinds of celebrations.

name: Red Century Party Shop Lelydorp
description: Red Century Party Shop Lelydorp covers Wanica district with party supplies, balloons, confetti, décor and tableware for events of all sizes. Practical stop for anyone in Lelydorp organising a birthday party or occasion.

name: Red Century Party Shop North
description: Red Century Party Shop North is the northern Paramaribo branch of the popular party supply chain, stocking decorations, balloons, themed tableware and event essentials for birthdays, weddings, baby showers and more.

name: Red Century Party Shop Zorg En Hoop
description: Red Century Party Shop Zorg en Hoop brings a full selection of party supplies, decorations and event materials to the Zorg en Hoop neighbourhood. One stop for balloons, banners and everything you need to throw a proper celebration.

name: Regionale Gezondheidsdienst
description: Regionale Gezondheidsdienst (RGD) is Suriname's public primary health care service, running a network of clinics in Paramaribo and in virtually all districts of the country. Its listed address is J.A. Pengelstraat 188 in Paramaribo.

name: Regis Hair Therapy
description: Regis Hair Therapy, formerly Studio Regis, is a hair salon at Zinniastraat 42 in Paramaribo. The new name reflects a concept focused on hair care and treatment, not only styling. Clients rate it highly.

description: Rekemo International Suriname is a management consulting and IT company at Corantijnstraat 20 in Paramaribo that develops software and is a member of the ICT Association Suriname.

name: RCFA - Accountants & Tax Lawyers
description: RCFA - Accountants & Tax Lawyers is a professional services firm in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering accounting, tax advice and consultancy. Located at Jacob Reintjestraat 2.

name: Remy Vastgoed
description: Remy Vastgoed is a Surinamese real estate company offering property sales, rentals and development advisory services. Trusted by clients for reliable property expertise.

name: Renaissance Realty N.V.

name: Rent & Sale Vastgoed
description: Rent & Sale Vastgoed is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering car rental, warehousing and property sales and rentals. Located at Kwattaweg 470.

name: Republic Bank Zorg en Hoop
description: Republic Bank Zorg en Hoop provides everyday banking services to the Zorg en Hoop district of Paramaribo, providing accounts, payments, loans and card services for local residents and small businesses.

name: Residence Inn Nickerie
description: Residence Inn Nickerie provides comfortable accommodation in Suriname's western Nickerie district, near the border with Guyana. A practical base for travellers and business visitors to the country's agricultural heartland.

description: Residence Inn Paramaribo offers apartment-style suites with full kitchen facilities for extended-stay guests in Paramaribo. Popular with business travellers on longer assignments, it combines the comfort of home with hotel services.

description: Restoran Bibit is a Javanese-Surinamese restaurant known for authentic Indonesian-influenced dishes including nasi, satay and rijsttafel. A long-standing name for traditional Javanese cooking in Suriname.

description: A care and mobility shop on Flustraat in Paramaribo, opposite the AZ pharmacy, selling and renting care equipment.

description: Rhythms of Nature Ayurveda Wellness Center is an Ayurvedic practice for preventive health care at Daimlerstraat 5 in Paramaribo. Besides consultations it runs courses, including healthy cooking with herbs and a women's health course. Contact +597 711-1960.

description: Rico's, A Gladiator Food Truck, is a Surinamese food truck and casual eatery serving bold-flavoured burgers, grills and street food. A hit with Paramaribo's foodie crowd.

name: Rif Cleaning Service
description: RIF Cleaning Service is a professional cleaning company in Suriname offering office, residential and post-construction cleaning. Takes on both one-off deep cleans and recurring contracts for commercial and private clients across Paramaribo.

description: Rijstpak N.V. is a Surinamese rice company on Lala Rookhweg 34 in Paramaribo, known for its Paloma brand of export-quality rice. The company was founded by Ramawat Soechit.

description: Rima Beauty Bar is a beauty salon on Louis Govea Street 60 in Paramaribo offering hair and nail services.

name: Ring Ring Imports
description: Ring Ring Imports is a Surinamese tech and electronics importer offering a range of devices, accessories and consumer electronics at competitive prices.

description: Ring Sport Center is a sports hall at Ringweg-Noord 36 in Paramaribo used for badminton and sports events. The Surinaamse Badminton Bond holds tournaments there, including the Suriname International and an annual beginners' tournament.

name: Ritas Roti Shop
description: Rita's Roti Shop is a Surinamese roti restaurant with freshly made roti skins and flavourful curried fillings. A community spot for authentic, affordable Hindustani-Surinamese cuisine.

description: Rock Cars is a car dealer at Schietbaanweg 1 in Paramaribo that buys and sells used cars, accepts trade-ins and can arrange financing. Contact +597 888-8770 or +597 859-1030.

name: Rock Fitness Paramaribo
description: Rock Fitness Paramaribo is a gym and personal training facility in the city offering functional fitness, bodybuilding, CrossFit and toning programmes. Trainers provide structured guidance for members across fitness levels. A straightforward gym setup focused on results.

name: Rogom Farm N.V.
description: Rogom Farm N.V. is an agricultural layer hen operation in Suriname producing fresh eggs and egg-based products including handmade mayonnaise. Supplies direct to consumers and commercial buyers, with products made from farm-fresh eggs and natural ingredients.

name: Rolines De Waag

description: Rossignol 2GO on Kwattaweg 355 in Paramaribo is an outlet of Rossignol, a Surinamese butcher chain selling quality local meat. It also serves ready-made dishes such as spicy chicken wings and chicken nuggets.

description: Rossignol Waaldijkstraat, at Waaldijkstraat 17 in Paramaribo, is a branch of Rossignol, a Surinamese butcher chain selling quality local meat prepared with modern techniques.

description: Royal Brasil Hotel offers luxurious accommodation at an accessible price in Paramaribo. Featuring well-appointed rooms, attentive service and a convenient city-centre location, it consistently earns top reviews as one of Suriname's best-value upscale hotels.

description: Royal Breeze Hotel Paramaribo is a city-centre hotel within walking distance of the historic waterfront and the Suriname River. Offers standard rooms and suites with the usual business hotel amenities, well-positioned for exploring central Paramaribo on foot.

description: A hotel and casino on Steenbakkerijstraat in central Paramaribo. The casino floor runs to roughly 740 square metres with over 70 slot machines and a dedicated poker room for Texas Hold'em and other variants, open around the clock, with valet parking on request.

name: Royal Panel

description: Royal Rose Yoni Spa in Paramaribo specialises in feminine wellness treatments including yoni steaming, body wraps and therapeutic massage. One of the few venues in Suriname focused specifically on women's wellness rituals and intimate self-care.

Its businesses include Rubecom, which produces soft drinks, juices, water and dairy, Waterland Cement Industry, Rudisa Bakery, a travel agency and Burger King franchise restaurants in Paramaribo.

description: Rudisa Motor Company is a car dealer on Hofstede Crull'laan and Mauriciusstraat in Paramaribo, selling brands such as Kia, SsangYong, Jeep and Chery, with parts and after-sales service.

description: Rudisa World Wide Travel is a travel agency in Paramaribo, established in 2000 as part of the Rudisa group. The group was founded in 1975 by Dilipkoemar Sardjoe and also has companies in distribution, manufacturing and building materials.

description: Rudra Vastgoed Suriname N.V. is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering property sales and rentals. Located at Frederikshoopweg 226.

description: RuStique Grill is a small, cosy restaurant at Kwattaweg 523 in Paramaribo serving authentic Surinamese food and grilled dishes, with a personal welcome for every guest. Contact +597 818-3495.

description: 's Lands Hospitaal is a general hospital at Tourtonnelaan 3 in Paramaribo, founded in 1760 as a military hospital and a general hospital since 1934. It specializes in pediatrics and neonatology, and its maternity department, where nearly half of Suriname's births take place, offers water births.

The group, founded in 1993, provides oilfield services including drilling, workover, well completion, reservoir management and project management.

description: Safety First Quality Always is a Surinamese occupational health and safety consultancy providing workplace safety training, audits and compliance services.

description: Saipem is an Italian engineering and drilling contractor working on TotalEnergies' offshore GranMorgu oil project in Suriname, where it is setting up a logistics base.

name: Sakura
description: Sakura is a restaurant serving Nikkei cuisine, a blend of Japanese and Peruvian cooking, at the Courtyard by Marriott hotel on Anton Drachtenweg in Paramaribo. The menu focuses on fresh seafood.

name: Sam Tronix Anamoestraat
description: Sam Tronix is a Samsung specialist in Paramaribo carrying phones, tablets, wearables and accessories, with service and warranty handling. This is the Anamoestraat branch.

name: Sam Tronix Wanica
description: The Wanica branch of Sam Tronix on the Indira Gandhiweg, carrying the same Samsung range of phones, tablets and accessories as the Paramaribo store.

name: Samba Cafe
description: Samba Café is a Brazilian-inspired café and bar in Paramaribo serving coffee, caipirinhas, snacks and light meals throughout the day. The outdoor seating and relaxed pace make it a popular spot for both a morning coffee and an afternoon drink.

name: Sana Budaya
description: Sana Budaya is a cultural and community centre of the Vereniging Herdenking Javaanse Immigratie (VHJI) in Suriname. The centre is dedicated to the preservation, promotion and transmission of Javanese and Surinamese cultural heritage. Sana Budaya provides a range of cultural, educational and community activities, including cultural events, performances, exhibitions, workshops, meetings and other public activities. The centre also provides facilities for cultural fairs, markets, sports and community gatherings. Located on the Sana Budaya premises are the Soeki Irodikromo Volksacademie voor Kunst en Cultuur (VAKC), which supports arts and cultural education, and V.H.J.I. Documentation Centre, which contributes to the preservation, documentation and accessibility of historical and cultural knowledge and materials related to Javanese heritage in Suriname.

name: Sanousch Books
description: Sanousch Books is a bookstore in Paramaribo stocking books, stationery and educational materials. One of the few dedicated book shops in Suriname's capital, carrying Dutch-language titles alongside English books, school supplies and gifts.

name: Saras Brunch Cafe
description: Sara's Brunch Café is a breakfast and brunch spot on Johannes Mungrastraat in Paramaribo, serving Surinamese sandwiches such as curry egg and shoarma in a garden setting.

name: Saro Shipping NV
description: Saro Shipping NV ships cargo between Suriname, the Caribbean, the USA and the Netherlands from its office at Ramnarain Oemrawweg 17, and is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

name: Sash Fashion Hermitage Mall
description: Sash Fashion at Hermitage Mall is a women's clothing boutique offering current styles, accessories and footwear.

name: Satyam Holidays
description: Satyam Holidays is a Surinamese travel agency offering holiday packages, flight bookings, hotel reservations and travel services for both outbound and inbound tourism.

name: Savoie Hotel & Apartments
description: A hotel and apartment block on Johannes Mungrastraat, about 3.7 km from the Central Market. Rooms are air conditioned with free wifi and a kettle, and some have a kitchen with microwave and fridge. Breakfast is served daily with continental, American and halal options, and one-bedroom furnished apartments are let separately with utilities included.

name: Saya N.V.
description: Saya N.V. is a car dealer on Hofstraat in Paramaribo that sells and rents vehicles and supplies parts, with in-house and bank financing.

description: SBT Suriname is the Paramaribo office of Japanese used-car exporter SBT, opened in 2015, selling Japanese used cars from Boni Street 27.

name: Scandia Gear the Caribbean Ltd.
description: Scandia Gear the Caribbean supplies certified safety workwear and personal protective equipment for offshore, maritime and industrial work, from Wilhelminastraat corner David Simonsstraat in Paramaribo.
address: Corner Wilhelminastraat & David Simonsstraat # 85B, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Scene Beauty Salon
description: Scene Beauty Salon is a beauty salon on Tweederijweg in Paramaribo offering skincare treatments such as microneedling, nail care and spa services, with online booking.

description: Securico BHV Opleidingscentrum, at Mankistraat 60 in Paramaribo, sets up company emergency response (BHV) teams and fire protection plans, and runs BHV, first aid and AED training.

name: Seen Stories
description: At Seen Stories, we uncover and share meaningful community stories. With six years of experience, we specialize in storytelling through documentaries and corporate commercials. Our goal is to create impactful stories that inspire, educate and connect locally and internationally. Most importantly, we want people to feel seen, heard, and valued.

name: Self Reliance Verzekeringen
description: Self Reliance Verzekeringen is a Surinamese insurer offering health, motor, travel, accident, fire, pension, funeral, term life and dental insurance, as well as roadside assistance. Its head office is on Heerenstraat and Henck Arronstraat in Paramaribo, with branches in Wanica and Nickerie.

name: SEMC Motors N.V.
description: SEMC Motors N.V. is the official Ford dealer in Suriname, on Kernkampweg in Paramaribo, also handling Land Rover, ARB 4x4 accessories, Hankook tires and Motorcraft parts, with parts and service.
address: W.J. Kernkampweg 32-34, Paramaribo, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

description: Sendang Redjo is an eco retreat in Tamanredjo, Commewijne, built on a former plantation around a private lake and kilometres of man-made creeks, about 20 minutes from Paramaribo. Visits and stays are by reservation only.

address: Vleesgroenteweg 6 - Intervast Village I - Kwatta, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

description: Shimmery Beauty Lounge is a beauty and lifestyle café in Paramaribo combining nail and skin services with coffee and light bites. A chic self-care destination.

description: SHLX Cafe is a breakfast, brunch and lunch spot on Verlengde Gemenlandsweg. Fresh coffee, lattes, matcha and chai alongside bagels, sandwiches, bowls and a wide range of desserts. Open Monday to Friday 8.00 to 17.30 and Saturday 9.00 to 15.00.

description: SHLX Collection is a Surinamese activewear brand for women, producing sports leggings, tops and gym sets. Sold primarily online and at pop-ups in Paramaribo, with a local production focus and sizes aimed at the Surinamese market.

description: SIB Signs & Designs designs, produces and installs signage in Suriname, including pylons, channel letters, lightboxes, car wraps and large-format prints, from Heliconstraat 34 in Paramaribo.

name: Silver Moon Resort
description: A small guesthouse-style property on Jessurunstraat, about 2.6 km from the centre of Paramaribo. Five units run from doubles to quads and apartments, each with air conditioning, a kitchenette, fridge, flat-screen TV and safe. There is a garden, a restaurant, a 24-hour reception and an airport shuttle, and pets are allowed.

name: Simple IT Systems N.V.
description: Simple IT Systems N.V. provides enterprise and SMB technology solutions, including video surveillance with AI camera analytics, from Dr. Sophie Redmondstraat 167 in Paramaribo.

description: Simson Gym is a Thai boxing and kickboxing school at Nieuwe Charlesburgweg 277 in Paramaribo, started in 2000 by Angelo Simson. It offers combat kickboxing for beginners and fighters, kickboxing fitness classes for women, classes for children aged 6 to 13 and private training.

name: Sint Vincentius Ziekenhuis
description: Sint Vincentius Ziekenhuis is a general hospital at Koninginnestraat 4 in central Paramaribo. It offers specialties including surgery, internal medicine, gynecology, pediatrics, orthopedics, neurology and urology, along with a pharmacy, laboratory, physiotherapy, endoscopy and an ambulance service.

name: SIOC N.V.
