name: Ston Eiland Resort
description: A resort on a peninsula in the Brokopondo reservoir at the foot of the Brownsberg, reached by dirt road from Brownsweg roughly 120 km south of Paramaribo. Cabins have beds and fans, and there is a restaurant and a boat dock for trips onto the lake, where drowned tree trunks still break the surface. Swimming, fishing and canoeing are the main draws.

name: Store4u
description: Store4U is a multi-category retail shop in Paramaribo selling clothing, electronics, household goods and general merchandise. Practical for everyday shopping across several product categories at accessible prices.

name: Strongbow Offshore Services
description: Strongbow Offshore Services is a Paramaribo outsourcing company, active since 2007, that handles customer service, administration and ICT helpdesk work for companies in the Netherlands. It is located at Waterlandstraat 17.

name: STVS
description: STVS (Surinaamse Televisie Stichting) is Suriname's state-owned television broadcaster, founded in 1965 as the country's first television station. It is based at Letitia Vriesdelaan 5 in Paramaribo and broadcasts news, sport and locally produced programs.

name: Subway (Lalla Rookhweg)
description: Subway in Paramaribo serves made-to-order sandwiches, wraps and salads with your choice of bread, fillings and toppings. The Suriname locations follow the standard Subway format, a quick, customisable option for lunch or a light meal in the city.

name: Subway (Jozef Israëlsstraat)
description: Subway on Jozef Israëlsstraat is one of Paramaribo's convenient sub sandwich locations, offering freshly made-to-order subs, wraps and salads with a full range of toppings.

name: Subway (Kwattaweg)
description: Subway on Kwattaweg brings the build-your-own sandwich experience to the Kwatta area of Paramaribo, serving freshly made subs, salads and wraps.

name: SUforYou Suriname
description: SUforYou is a tour operator on Henck Arronstraat in Paramaribo selling day excursions, multi-day trips into the interior and round trips through Suriname.

name: Sugar
description: Sugar is a modern Asian fusion restaurant on Plutostraat in Paramaribo with a menu that changes every quarter and regular live music evenings.

name: Sun Ice
description: Sun Ice is a bakery with several branches in Paramaribo, including one on Johan Adolf Pengelstraat, selling fresh bread, pastries, cakes and cookies.

name: Sun Smile Hotel & Apartments
description: A hotel and apartment property on Jacabastraat, about 3.5 km from the Central Market and 3 km from the Surinaams Museum. There is a 24-hour front desk, a terrace and free wifi, some rooms have balconies, and breakfast is served each morning either continental or a la carte.

name: Sundae Bliss
description: An ice cream shop in Shafantur Mall on Verlengde Gemenelandsweg. Open Tuesday to Saturday from midday to 8pm and Sunday from 4pm, closed Mondays.
address: Verlengde Gemenelandsweg 147, unit 115-116, Shafantur Mall, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: SUNRICE N.V
description: SUNRICE N.V. is a rice mill at Longmay 64 in Nickerie that has been trading in rice since 1986, with products including brown rice.

name: Super Merchandise Motors
description: Super Merchandise Motors is a used car dealership at Jaggernath Lachmonstraat 60 in Paramaribo, in business since 1999. From its showroom it sells a range of used vehicles, including Toyota and Nissan models, and offers financing options.

name: Superior Tank and Pipe Group N.V.
description: Superior Tank and Pipe Group N.V. is an engineering, procurement and construction contractor for the oil, gas and water industries, based at Larecoweg 28 in Saramacca and serving Suriname, Guyana and the Caribbean.

name: Supply Solutions Limited Suriname
description: Supply Solutions Limited is a Surinamese procurement and supply chain company providing sourcing, logistics and supply services for businesses across sectors.

name: Sura Handelmaatschappij nv
description: Sura Handelmaatschappij nv is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tiles, sanitary ware and plumbing supplies. Located at Duisburglaan 39.

name: Suran Adventures Tours & Travel
description: Suran Adventures Tours & Travel is a Surinamese adventure tour operator offering jungle treks, river expeditions, cultural tours and travel agency services across Suriname.

name: Suraniyat
description: Suraniyat is a Surinamese fashion house producing clothing rooted in traditional craft techniques and cultural motifs. The brand works with artisan methods and cultural expression, positioned between fashion and wearable craft, with a small-batch production approach.

name: Surgoed Makelaardij
description: Surgoed Makelaardij is a reputable Surinamese real estate agency specialising in property sales, appraisals and rental management. Known for transparent, professional service.

name: Suri Juice N.V.
description: Suri Juice N.V. is a fruit juice producer based at Kokrikilaan 44 in Paramaribo.

name: Surichange Bank N.V.
description: Surichange Bank N.V. is a bank in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering banking services and insurance cover. Located at Dr Sophie Redmond St 71.
address: Dr Sophie Redmond St 71, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Surinaamsche Waterleiding Maatschappij
description: Surinaamsche Waterleiding Maatschappij (SWM) is Suriname's national water supply company, responsible for treating and distributing clean drinking water across Paramaribo and surrounding districts.

name: Surinaamse Badminton Bond (SuBaBo)
description: Surinaamse Badminton Bond (SuBaBo) is the national badminton federation of Suriname, promoting the sport and organizing events such as the Suriname International tournament and an annual beginners' tournament. These events have been held at the Ring Sport Center on Ringweg-Noord in Paramaribo.

name: Surinaamse Brouwerij N.V.
description: Surinaamse Brouwerij brews Parbo, the national beer, along with Parbo Radler and locally brewed Heineken, and distributes imported beers and spirits.
address: Surinaamse Brouwerij NV Brouwerijweg #1 Paramaribo – Suriname, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Surinaamse Postspaarbank
description: Surinaamse Postspaarbank is a state-owned Surinamese bank focused on savings products, with roots going back to the Koloniale Spaarbank of 1880. It also offers personal loans, car financing, mortgages and business banking, with its main office at Knuffelsgracht 10-14 in Paramaribo and a branch in Nickerie.

name: Surinam Airways
description: Surinam Airways is the national airline of Suriname, operating scheduled flights connecting Paramaribo to destinations across the Caribbean, South America and Europe, including direct services to Amsterdam. The primary carrier for international travel to and from Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport.

name: Surinam Plastics Manufacturing N.V.
description: Surinam Plastics Manufacturing N.V. is a Paramaribo manufacturer of flexible plastic packaging, operating since 1970. It is located at Nieuwe Charlesburgweg 85.
address: Nieuwe Charlesburgweg 85 , Paramaribo, Suriname, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Surinam Shipping Agencies
description: Surinam Shipping Agencies is a liner and port agent in Paramaribo, located at Zwartenhovenbrugstraat 242 in the city centre.

name: Suriname Alcoholic Beverages
description: Suriname Alcoholic Beverages is a rum distiller on Cornelis Jongbawstraat in Paramaribo, founded in 1966. It produces Surinamese rum brands including Borgoe, Marienburg, Black Cat and Hanappier, as well as Voltz vodka.

name: Suriname Bush clearing and Mining NV
description: Suriname Bushclearing and Mining N.V. (SB&M) rents out heavy equipment and carries out specialised projects for the mining and forestry sector. It is based at Lallarookhweg 44, Paramaribo.

name: Suriname Cloud Services
description: Suriname Cloud Services is a technology and media company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering cloud and hosting and cybersecurity. Located at Hofstraat 1 – 1e Etage.

name: Suriname Energy Chamber
description: The Suriname Energy Chamber (SEC) is a national platform for Suriname's energy sector that promotes sustainable energy solutions and partnerships. Its office is at Julianastraat 56, Paramaribo.

name: Suriname-Guyana Chamber of Commerce (SGCC)
description: The Suriname-Guyana Chamber of Commerce (SGCC) promotes bilateral trade and investment between Suriname and Guyana. Its listed office is at 20 Mc Doom, East Bank Demerara, Guyana.
address: 20 Mc Doom, East Bank Demerara , Guyana

name: Suriname Hospitality and Tourism Training Centre -SHTTC
description: The Suriname Hospitality and Tourism Training Centre (SHTTC) is the national vocational training institute for hospitality and tourism, based on Gravenberchstraat in Paramaribo.

name: SHATA - Suriname Hospitality and Tourism Association
description: The trade body for Suriname's tourism and hospitality sector, founded in 2012. SHATA represents members nationally and internationally, builds partnerships with government and industry, and feeds policy recommendations into tourism development.

name: Suriname Hotel Association
description: The Suriname Hotel Association is the national association of hotels in Suriname, representing the hotel sector towards government and the tourism industry. It is based at Mr. L.J. Rietbergplein 1 in Paramaribo; see surinamehotels.org.

name: Suriname Motors NV.
description: Suriname Motors NV. is an automotive business at Kolonistenweg 70 in the Welgelegen area of Paramaribo, Suriname. The company offers vehicle sales and runs a car repair workshop at this address.

name: Suriname Pest Control
description: Suriname Pest Control is a pest control company based at Zonnebloemstraat 59 in Paramaribo.

name: Suriname Princess Casino
description: Suriname Princess Casino is a gaming and entertainment complex offering table games, slot machines, hotel accommodation and dining in Paramaribo.

name: Suriname Sea Catch NV
description: Suriname Sea Catch N.V. is a Paramaribo seafood company that supplies fresh and frozen fish and exports fish products. It is located at Tennisbalstraat No. 9.

name: Suriname Tuk Tuk Tours
description: Guided tuk-tuk tours around Paramaribo and its surroundings, covering the historic quarter and running out to the former Peperpot plantation.

name: Suriname Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A rescue and rehabilitation centre for native wildlife, founded by Matthijs and Valeska Kuijpers who moved to Suriname in 2024. Unlike most shelters it takes a wide range of species, from capuchin monkeys and parrots to boas and sloths. Injured, orphaned and confiscated animals get medical care and, where possible, release back to the wild. The site covers around 100 hectares of forest with creeks running through it, and takes eco-volunteers on stays from one week.

name: SuriSkin Healthcare
description: SuriSkin Healthcare is a dermatology and cosmetic dermatology practice in Paramaribo, treating skin conditions and offering cosmetic treatments such as botox and fillers.

name: SuriTech N.V.
description: SuriTech N.V. is an IT company in central Paramaribo offering computer hardware repair, networking and data recovery services. The company also sells laptops and provides IT consulting for its customers in Suriname.

name: Surpost
description: Surpost is the national postal company of Suriname, with its main post office at Kerkplein 1 in central Paramaribo. It handles letters, parcels and registered mail, courier and air and sea cargo, and financial services such as postal money orders and Western Union transfers.

name: SurShipp
description: A freight forwarder and personal shopping service connecting Suriname to the United States, Europe and Asia. Air and sea cargo import with a pickup point on the Zwartenhovenbrugstraat.

name: Susan's Houtmarkt
description: Susan's Houtmarkt is a timber supplier on Johannes Mungra straat 75 in Paramaribo, selling wood with a range of finishes for construction and renovation projects.

name: Sushi-Ya
description: Sushi Ya is a sushi restaurant in Paramaribo serving Japanese-style rolls, sashimi and nigiri with some local Surinamese twists on ingredients. One of the more established sushi spots in the capital, popular for lunch and dinner with a menu suited to both sushi regulars and beginners.

name: Sutopia Resort
description: A small aparthotel on Weg naar Peperpot in Meerzorg, set on the Suriname River among native planting. Eight individually decorated rooms have kitchenettes and private patios, and there is an outdoor pool, garden and bar. Peperpot Nature Park and Jodensavanne are both within about fifteen minutes drive.

name: SuUndergrnd
description: SuUnderGrnd is a new movement that celebrates the beauty of humanity and nature. Every gathering strangers became friends, creating a new kind of festival where everyone participates making each time more beautiful than the other… Welcome to a new Suriname where you can dance with our brilliant new & talented techno and house DJ’s on our next exotic location in heart of the Amazon. Welcome to SuUnderGrnd!🖤

name: Sweet Tooth Pastries
description: Sweet Tooth Pastries is a Paramaribo bakery making custom celebration cakes, cupcakes and artisan pastries to order for birthdays, weddings and corporate events. The walk-in display carries fresh daily bakes: decorated layer cakes, flavoured cupcakes and seasonal pastries.

name: Sweetheart Hermitage Mall
description: Sweetheart is a toy store and calls itself the most complete toy shop in Paramaribo, with toys for babies to teenagers and gifts for grown-ups. This branch is in Hermitage Mall on Lalla Rookhweg; there is also a branch in the International Mall of Suriname.

name: Sweetheart IMS
description: Sweetheart is a toy and candy store in Paramaribo; this branch is in the International Mall of Suriname on Ringweg-Zuid.

name: Sweetie Coffee
description: Sweetie Coffee is a sweet-focused café in Paramaribo serving flavoured coffees, milkshakes, desserts and pastries. A playful café popular with younger visitors.

name: Sweets & Brews by Nass
description: Sweets & Brews by Nass is a cafeteria on Mahonylaan in Paramaribo serving coffee, sweets and brunch dishes, for dine-in or takeout.

name: Switi Momenti Candles & Crafts
description: Switi Momenti is a Surinamese candle and crafts brand making scented handmade candles and artisan gift products. A good source for personal treats or Surinamese-made gifts.

name: T & H Groep Accountants & Belastingadviseurs
description: T & H Groep Accountants & Belastingadviseurs is a professional services firm in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering accounting, tax advice and audit services. Located at Rode Kruislaan 10.

name: 'T VAT Sidewalk Cafe
description: 't Vat is the landmark café-bar of Paramaribo's Kleine Waterstraat nightlife strip, with a large covered terrace, live music most weekends, and a menu that runs from Surinamese staples to burgers and pizza. A long-standing first stop for visitors finding their feet in the city.

name: Talking Prints Concept Store
description: Talking Prints is a Suriname slow fashion and lifestyle brand founded in 2015, selling handmade bags, accessories and gifts made by makers from Maroon and Indigenous communities.

name: Talula
description: Talula is a boutique in Paramaribo offering a curated selection of clothing, accessories and lifestyle items, known for its stylish interior and personal service.

name: Taman Indah Resort
description: Taman Indah Resort is a peaceful resort near Paramaribo featuring lush gardens, a pool and comfortable bungalows. The property draws on Indonesian-inspired design and offers a relaxed atmosphere ideal for families and couples.

name: Tapauku Terras
description: Tapauku Terras is an outdoor terrace bar and restaurant in Paramaribo offering a relaxed open-air atmosphere, drinks and light bites with a Surinamese spirit.

name: Tastelicious
description: Tastelicious is a dessert business on Pommeroosestraat in Paramaribo making homemade tiramisu, mini dessert cups, snack boxes and dessert tables for occasions.

name: Tasty Fresh Food Coffee Bar
description: Tasty Fresh Food & Coffee Bar is a health-conscious café in Paramaribo offering fresh juices, smoothies, sandwiches and coffee. A bright, energising spot for a healthy start.

name: TBL Cinemas
description: TBL Cinemas is a cinema on Lalla Rookhweg in Paramaribo with five screens, including RealD 3D and Dolby 3D, showing Hollywood, Bollywood and other international films.

name: TCF n.v
description: TCF N.V. (Tammenga Contracting & Furniture) is a contracting and furniture company on Kolonistenweg in Paramaribo, active since 2001 in residential construction.

name: Teasee
description: Teasee is a tea house on Van Roseveltkade in Paramaribo with a tea shop and café, tea workshops and ceremonies, a gift shop and a mini library, and it hosts high teas and private events.

name: Technovate N.V.
description: Technovate N.V. is an IT company on Rode Sterweg 10 in Nieuw Meerzorg providing AI automation, Odoo ERP, managed IT and cybersecurity services to organizations in Suriname and abroad.

name: Tegeldepot Suriname
description: Tegeldepot Suriname is a tile retailer on Calcuttastraat in Paramaribo selling floor and wall tiles, sanitary ware and home accessories, with advice and online ordering.

name: Teleperformance Suriname
description: Teleperformance (TP) Suriname is a customer contact specialist in Paramaribo, active in Suriname since 2015, with an office at Surinamestraat 72 and options to work from home.

name: Telesur Centrum
description: Telesur Centrum is a branch of Telesur, Suriname's largest telecommunications provider, at Heiligenweg 14 in central Paramaribo. Customers can pay their Telesur bills here and buy mobile phones, calling cards, e-top-up credit and SIM cards.

name: Telesur Havenlaan
description: The Telesur service point on the Havenlaan Zuid, for internet, mobile and fixed line services.

name: Telesur Hoofdkantoor
description: Telesur Hoofdkantoor is the head office of Telesur, Suriname's largest telecommunications provider, at Heiligenweg 14 in Paramaribo. Telesur was formed in 1981 from the former state telegraph and telephone company LTT and provides mobile, internet and fixed-line services for private and business customers.

name: Telesur Latour
description: Telesur Latour is a branch of Suriname's national telecom provider serving the Latour district with internet, mobile and landline services.

name: Telesur Lelydorp
description: Telesur Lelydorp is a branch of Telesur, Suriname's largest telecommunications provider, at Indira Gandhiweg 474 in Lelydorp, Wanica. Customers can pay their Telesur bills here and buy mobile phones, calling cards, e-top-up credit and SIM cards.

name: Telesur Moengo
description: The Telesur branch at Moengo in Marowijne, serving the east of the country with internet, mobile and fixed line services.

name: Telesur Nickerie
description: Telesur Nickerie is a branch of Telesur, Suriname's largest telecommunications provider, at Oostkanaalstraat 3 in Nieuw Nickerie, serving the Nickerie district. Customers can pay their Telesur bills here and buy mobile phones, calling cards, e-top-up credit and SIM cards.

name: Telesur Noord
description: Telesur Noord is a branch of Telesur, Suriname's largest telecommunications provider, on the corner of Nikkelstraat and Kristalstraat in Paramaribo Noord. Customers can pay their Telesur bills here and buy mobile phones, calling cards, e-top-up credit and SIM cards.

name: Telesur Tamanredjo
description: The Telesur branch serving Tamanredjo and the surrounding Commewijne district, on the Pandit Tilakdhariweg at Alkmaar.

name: Telesur Telecommunicatie Museum
description: A telecommunications museum run by Telesur, covering the history of the network in Suriname.

name: Telesur Zonnebloemstraat
description: Telesur Zonnebloemstraat is a branch of Telesur, Suriname's largest telecommunications provider, at Zonnebloemstraat 50 in Paramaribo. Customers can pay their Telesur bills here and buy mobile phones, calling cards, e-top-up credit and SIM cards.

name: Terraform Engineering & Design N.V. (TED N.V.)
description: Terraform Engineering & Design N.V. (TED N.V.) is an engineering and design firm in Paramaribo that designs and builds homes. It is located at Ramsoedhweg #38.

name: Terzol Vastgoed NV
description: Terzol Vastgoed NV is a real estate company in Paramaribo that values and sells homes, building lots, commercial sites and investment property across Suriname.
address: Gravenberchstraat hoek, Del Prado Straat 18A, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: The Aerial Yoga Studio
description: The Aerial Yoga Studio is Suriname's dedicated aerial yoga facility, offering classes in aerial yoga, silks and anti-gravity fitness. A unique and empowering fitness experience.

name: The Ark Hotel
description: A small hotel on Anton Dragtenweg in Paramaribo. Rooms are air conditioned and non-smoking, with room service and wifi. The restaurant serves regional and European dishes, there is a bar, and breakfast can be brought to the room on request. Airport and shuttle transfers are available at extra cost.

name: The Bakery House
description: The Bakery House is an artisan bakery in Paramaribo turning out fresh bread, pastries, cakes and savoury baked goods daily. Known for consistent quality and a proper bakery feel, it draws a steady morning crowd for breakfast pastries and coffee.

name: The Basement Barbershop
description: The Basement Barbershop is a men's grooming spot in Paramaribo offering precision haircuts, fades, beard trims and classic barbershop services.

name: The Beauty Bar
description: The Beauty Bar is a hair and beauty salon in Paramaribo offering blowouts, hair extensions, nail services, lashes and skin treatments. Known for quality hair work, particularly blowouts and colour, with a clientele that books ahead for the popular stylists.

name: The Beauty Bar North
description: The Beauty Bar North is the northern Paramaribo branch of the local hair and beauty salon group, offering blowouts, extensions, nail treatments and lash services. Same quality focus as the main location, more conveniently positioned for clients north of the city centre.

name: The Beauty Bar South
description: The Beauty Bar South serves southern Paramaribo with the same hair styling, nail and beauty treatment menu as the other branches. Blowouts, extensions and nail services available, with booking recommended for peak times.

name: The Caterpillar Montessorischool
description: The Caterpillar Montessorischool is an education institute at Martiniquestraat 7 in Paramaribo. It helps with curriculum development and homeschool set-up, guides parents, supports students writing reports and theses, and runs childcare during holidays. Contact +597 815-3524.

name: The Coffee Box
description: The Coffee Box is a café and grill in Paramaribo combining specialty coffee with a food menu of grilled dishes, sandwiches and breakfast plates. A solid all-day option that works as well for a morning coffee as it does for a proper sit-down lunch.

name: The Coffee Box North
description: The Coffee Box North is the northern Paramaribo branch of the popular specialty coffee brand, serving expertly brewed coffees and snacks.

name: The Coffee Hobbyist
description: The Coffee Hobbyist is a specialty coffee shop in Paramaribo that takes brewing seriously. Single-origin beans, manual brewing methods and trained baristas define the offer. The place for proper filter coffee or an espresso made the right way, with a quieter atmosphere than the bigger café chains.

name: The Freelance Scout
description: The Freelance Scout is a Surinamese platform and consultancy connecting businesses with freelance professionals across creative, tech and business disciplines.

name: The Girl House
description: The Girl House is a nail studio in Paramaribo offering manicures, pedicures, nail art and personal-care treatments in a relaxed, social setting.

name: The Golden Truly Hotel
description: The Golden Truly Hotel & Casino is a centrally located Paramaribo hotel offering rooms, a casino, bar and meeting facilities. Positioned for business travellers and visitors who want city-centre access with on-site entertainment.

name: The House of Beauty
description: The House of Beauty is a beauty salon in Munster, Paramaribo offering facials, waxing, hair care, full-body massage, manicures, pedicures and body scrubs. A full-service salon covering most beauty treatment needs in one location.

name: The Laundry Spot
description: The Laundry Spot is a full-service laundry and dry cleaning facility in Paramaribo offering wash-and-fold, dry cleaning and express laundry services.

name: The Maillard Cafe
description: The Maillard Café is a sophisticated café and patisserie in Paramaribo serving artisan pastries, specialty coffees and creative brunch dishes.

name: The Nail House
description: The Nail House is a nail salon in Paramaribo offering gel, acrylic, dip powder and nail art services alongside manicures and pedicures. A focused nail-only setup with trained technicians and a proper range of finishes and designs.

name: The Old Attic
description: The Old Attic is a gift and collectibles shop in Paramaribo carrying accessories, jewellery, anime merchandise, vintage collectables and novelty items. The kind of shop where you browse longer than planned. Popular with students and collectors.

name: The Old Garage
description: The Old Garage is a bar and casual dining spot in Paramaribo set inside a converted industrial space, with exposed brick, cold beers and a laid-back crowd. Known for grilled snacks, cocktails and live music nights, it's one of the city's more characterful after-work and weekend hangouts.

name: The Perfume Spot
description: The Perfume Spot is a fragrance boutique in Paramaribo stocking perfumes, colognes and body mists from local and international brands. In-store testers and staff who know the range make it easy to match scents to your preference.

name: The Ramada Rooftop Lounge & Bar
description: The Ramada Rooftop Lounge & Bar sits on the fourth floor of Ramada Paramaribo Princess on Kleine Waterstraat, serving Mediterranean dishes and barbecue with a view over the city.

name: The Smile Factory
description: The Smile Factory is a dental clinic on J.S. Greenstraat 54 in Paramaribo, where dentists, dental hygienists and assistants work as a team on oral health care.

name: The Solution Property Management
description: The Solution Property Management provides professional property management and maintenance services in Paramaribo, handling rentals, tenant relations and facility management.

name: Suriname Tourism Board
description: Suriname Tourism Board is the national tourism organisation of Suriname, based at Prof. W.J.A. Kernkampweg 37 in Paramaribo. It promotes the country's natural and cultural attractions to visitors, from heritage, local music and cuisine to jungle treks, waterfalls and wildlife.

name: The Sweetest Thing
description: The Sweetest Thing is a dessert and pastry brand in Suriname offering custom cakes, cupcakes and sweet gifts for all occasions.

name: The Uma Store
description: The Uma Store is a retail space in Suriname selling artisan goods, local food specialties and handmade products that reflect the country's cultural diversity. The store operates with a focus on sustainability and direct support for local producers and artisans. A good option for visitors looking for authentic Surinamese products beyond standard tourist goods.

name: The Warehouse Shop
description: The Warehouse Shop is a furniture store on Dr. Ir. H.S. Adhinstraat 23 in Paramaribo, selling affordable furniture, household appliances and office equipment.

name: The Waxing Booth and More by SG
description: The Waxing Booth is a waxing specialist salon in Paramaribo focused entirely on hair removal services: body waxing, facial waxing, brow shaping and related treatments. A clean, professional setup with experienced therapists and proper hygiene standards.

name: The WonderLab Su
description: The WonderLab Su is a beauty salon at Louis Goveastraat 25 in Paramaribo offering manicures, pedicures and waxing treatments.

name: Theater Thalia
description: Theater Thalia is Paramaribo's main performing arts venue, staging theatre productions, live music, dance performances and comedy shows year-round in a beautifully preserved colonial building. Home to both local productions and visiting international acts. Check the schedule before visiting.

name: Themen Contractors NV
description: Themen Contractors NV is a contractor on Indira Gandhiweg 1297 in Onverwacht, Para, carrying out transport and drilling work for private and corporate clients.

name: Thermen Hermitage Turkish Bath & Beautycenter
description: Thermen Hermitage is a Turkish bath and beauty centre in Paramaribo offering hammam steam baths, body treatments, massages and beauty services. A luxurious wellness experience inspired by traditional Turkish bathing culture.

name: Thorax Centrum Paramaribo
description: Thorax Centrum Paramaribo (TCP) is the heart centre of the Academisch Ziekenhuis Paramaribo on Flustraat, opened in November 2008. It focuses on the prevention, specialist diagnosis and treatment of heart and vascular disease. Patients are seen by referral and appointment. Contact +597 442-222.

name: Three Little Beans
description: Three Little Beans is a specialty coffee shop and café in Paramaribo focused on artisan coffee, freshly baked goods and a warm, community-focused atmosphere.

name: Tian You Paranam
description: A bubble tea shop at La Vigilantia on the Meursweg in Para.

name: Tianyou Aquafun
description: Tianyou AquaFun is a water park and aquatic recreation centre in Paramaribo offering pools, water slides and family entertainment. A popular destination for cooling off in Suriname's tropical heat.

name: Tilburg Tours & Rentals Suriname
description: Tilburg Tours & Rentals combines guided tours with airport transfers and a small car rental fleet, run from an office on Jessurunstraat in Paramaribo.

name: Timeless Barber and Nail Shop
description: Timeless Barber and Nail Shop in Paramaribo offers haircuts, beard shaves, manicures and pedicures under one roof. The combination of barbershop and nail services makes it a practical stop for clients who want grooming and nail care in a single visit.
address: Jan Besar Sarno Rebostraat #10, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Tiny House Tropical Appartment
description: Tiny House Tropical Apartment offers a compact, stylishly designed holiday apartment in Paramaribo. Ideal for solo travellers and couples, the property combines modern amenities with tropical character at an affordable nightly rate.

name: Tio Boto Eco Resort
description: Tio Boto Eco Resort is a riverside eco-lodge in Suriname's interior, built and managed by the local Maroon community. Guests can enjoy guided jungle treks, river swimming, traditional Maroon crafts and authentic Surinamese hospitality.

name: Tipsy Bar Lounge
description: Tipsy Bar & Lounge is a nightlife venue in Paramaribo with creative cocktails, a relaxed lounge atmosphere and regular DJ events.

name: Tirzahs Patisserie
description: Tirzah's Patisserie is an artisan pastry shop in Paramaribo known for beautifully crafted celebration cakes, tarts and desserts made to order. The go-to for weddings and birthdays when presentation matters as much as taste.

name: Tjong A Hung Accountants & Consultants
description: Tjong A Hung Accountants & Consultants is a multidisciplinary accountancy and consultancy firm located at Mr. Jagernath Lachmonstraat 158 in central Paramaribo.
address: Mr. Jagernath Lachmonstraat 158, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Tohora Automotive N.V.
description: Tohora Automotive N.V. is the authorised BMW dealer in Suriname, located at Johan Adolf Pengelstraat 143-145 in Paramaribo.
address: Johan Adolf Pengel Street, 143 - 145, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Tolzo Suriname
description: Tolzo Suriname (Tolzo N.V.) is a call centre in Paramaribo providing customer service, technical support for accounting software, telesales, data enrichment and data entry for clients in the Netherlands.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures
description: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures is an outdoor store selling gear, equipment and accessories for outdoor activities, with this location at Wagenwegstraat 71 in central Paramaribo. The chain has further stores elsewhere in Paramaribo as well as in Lelydorp and Meerzorg.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures Hermitage
description: Tomahawk at Hermitage Mall is an outdoor shop selling gear and equipment for outdoor activities. Part of the Tomahawk chain in Suriname.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures IMS
description: Tomahawk at the International Mall of Suriname offers outdoor gear, equipment and accessories. Part of the Tomahawk chain across Paramaribo.

name: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures Lelydorp
description: Tomahawk Outdoor Adventures in Lelydorp is a branch of the Surinamese outdoor store selling gear for camping, fishing, hunting and boating.

name: Tong Li N.v Zinkplaten en Alluminium Glazen Fabriek
description: Tong Li N.V. is a Paramaribo factory making zinc roofing sheets and aluminium sliding windows and doors, located on Johannes Mungrastraat at the corner of Virolastraat.
address: Johannes mungrastraat hk virolastraat, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Topslager Stolk
description: Topslager Stolk is a premium butcher shop in Suriname offering high-quality fresh meats, speciality cuts and prepared meat products.

name: Topsport
description: Topsport N.V. is a sporting goods store on Zwartenhovenbrugstraat in Paramaribo, founded in 1972, selling sports articles and fitness equipment.

name: Torarica Group
description: Torarica Group is a hotel group based at Mr. L.J. Rietbergplein in Paramaribo, operating three hotels: Torarica Resort, Eco Torarica and Royal Torarica.

name: Torarica Resort
description: Torarica Resort is a large riverfront resort complex in Paramaribo with pools, a casino, multiple dining outlets, sports facilities and a spa. One of the longest-established resort properties in Suriname, popular for weekend stays, events and as a leisure base for business travellers.

name: Tori Oso
description: Tori Oso, Sranan for story house, is a cafe-restaurant on Fred Derbystraat in Paramaribo, open since 1991. The kitchen is built around burgers, with pasta nights, snacks and cocktails alongside. As much a place to sit, drink and talk as to eat. Closed Mondays.

name: Total Building Technologies N.V.
description: Total Building Technologies N.V. is a security company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering IT services and security services. Located at Gongrijpstraat #301.

name: Total Surveying
description: Total Surveying is a real estate agency in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering legal services, property sales and rentals and construction. Located at Ronaldlaan 6.

name: TotalEnergies EP Suriname B.V.
description: TotalEnergies EP Suriname B.V. is the exploration and production affiliate of TotalEnergies in Suriname and operator of the GranMorgu development, with a branch office at Recolaan 17 in Paramaribo.

name: Touch Of Heaven Wellness
description: Touch of Heaven Wellness is a health massage clinic on Herman D. Benjaminstraat 11 in Paramaribo, offering therapeutic massages including fertility massage.

name: Tourbox Suriname
description: A tour operator working out of the Kleine Waterstraat bus square by 't Vat, offering plantation and history trips, dolphin and caiman spotting, canoe trips, mountain bike tours with jungle overnights, and longer runs into the interior by bus, boat or light aircraft.

name: Tourtonne's Taxi
description: Tourtonne's Taxi & Airport Service is a taxi company on Tourtonnelaan in Paramaribo, running for over 30 years, offering city rides, airport transfers and city tours.

name: Tout Tout Petit
description: Tout Tout Petit is a French-inspired bakery in Paramaribo with fresh daily bakes, croissants, pastries and custom cakes. A neighbourhood favourite for morning coffee and weekend treats.

name: Toys N More
description: Toys N More is a toy and games shop in Suriname stocking action figures, board games, educational sets, puzzles, remote-control vehicles and gifts for children of all ages. A reliable go-to for birthday shopping and holiday gifts across Paramaribo, with friendly staff who can help find the right present.

name: TRADE Outlet Center
description: TRADE Outlet Center is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tiles, sanitary ware and hardware. Located at Copernicus St 175.

name: Tran Elite Hotel Apartments
description: A hotel and apartment property on Jacques Gompertstraat in Paramaribo Noord, a couple of minutes from Maretraite Mall and about ten from Palmentuin. There is a 24-hour front desk, laundry and dry cleaning, free self parking and an airport shuttle at extra cost.

name: Tranquil At Mamba Republiek
description: Tranquil is a guesthouse at Mamba 19 in Republiek, on the outskirts of Paramaribo, offering a secluded stay for nature lovers.

name: Tranquil Massage
description: Tranquil Massage is a professional massage therapy studio in Paramaribo offering Swedish, deep tissue and relaxation massages. Known for skilled therapists and a calm, welcoming environment.

name: Transolution Cargo Caribbean N.V.
description: Transolution Cargo Caribbean N.V. is a shipping and logistics company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering freight forwarding. Located at Anton de Komstraat 42-46.

name: Travel The Guianas
description: A tour agency on Parijsstraat in Paramaribo specialising in trips across all three Guianas - Suriname, Guyana and French Guiana.

name: Traverco Truck & Tire Service N.V.
description: Traverco Truck & Tire Service N.V. sells and repairs tyres for cars, pick-ups, trucks, tractors and heavy equipment, and is the official Castrol lubricants retailer in Suriname. Located on Industrieweg Noord in Paramaribo.

name: Traymore NV Moengo Port
description: Traymore N.V. Moengo Port is an ISO 9001 and ISPS certified private port facility in Moengo, Marowijne, providing vessel handling, oil bunkering and storage for oil and gas, mining, bulk and breakbulk cargo.

name: Triple Security Unit
description: Triple Security Unit is a security company at Henri J. de Vriesstraat 10 in Rainville, Paramaribo, offering professional, reliable and affordable guarding services for businesses and private clients. See triple-security.com.

name: Trizzle's Beauty Spot
description: A beauty and personal care salon on Van Idsingastraat in Paramaribo.

name: Tromoto N.V.
description: Tromoto N.V., formerly Tropical Motors N.V., is the Paramaribo representative for Grohe taps, Geberit sanitary systems, Franklin Electric pumps, Wilson Art and McQuay air conditioners, located at Nieuwe Charlesburgweg 59.

name: Tropa de Elite Paintball
description: A paintball venue in Suriname, run alongside the Tropa de Elite paintball team. One of the few places in the country set up for the sport.

name: Tropical Breeze Apartments
description: Tropical Breeze Apartments offers two-bedroom self-catering apartments on Lalla Rookhweg, each with a full kitchen and living room. Suited to families and small groups.

name: Tropicana Hotel Casino
description: Tropicana Hotel & Casino is a full-service hotel and entertainment complex in Paramaribo. Featuring a casino, hotel rooms, restaurant and bar, it is a lively option for guests seeking both accommodation and nightlife entertainment.

name: Trustbank Amanah
description: Trustbank Amanah is an Islamic bank in Paramaribo that converted from a conventional bank in 2017, becoming the first Islamic bank in South America. It offers current and savings accounts, term deposits, a Hajj savings plan, personal, mortgage, vehicle and business financing, and internet, mobile and WhatsApp banking.

name: Tsw Group
description: TSW Group of Companies supplies building materials and interior solutions from Josephine Samson Greenstraat 79 in Paramaribo, covering projects from construction to fit-out.

name: Tucan Resort and Spa
description: Tucan Resort & Spa is a wellness-focused resort near Paramaribo offering spa treatments, a pool and comfortable bungalow lodging in a lush, tranquil setting, suited to relaxation and short retreats near Paramaribo.

name: Tucker Energy Services Limited
description: Tucker Energy Services is a Trinidad-based oilfield services company supplying services and products to the energy industry, with its Suriname head office at Lachmonstraat 158, Paramaribo and a site office in Saramacca.

name: Tulip Cafeteria
description: Tulip Cafeteria serves breakfast, lunch, snacks, pastries, warm meals and drinks for takeaway and pickup at the Tulip supermarkets on Tourtonnelaan and Verlengde Gemenelandsweg in Paramaribo.

name: Tulip Supermarket
description: Tulip Supermarket on the Tourtonnelaan is the original Tulip store, opened in 2009 by the wholesale distributor Amazone International N.V. It stocks fresh produce, groceries, household essentials and a wide range of imported international brands. Tulip's second, larger store is on the Verlengde Gemenelandsweg.

name: Tulip Supermarket (Verl. Gemenelandsweg)
description: Tulip II on the Verlengde Gemenelandsweg is Tulip's newest and largest store: a two-floor premium supermarket with more than 65,000 products and over 500 free parking spaces. Departments include fresh produce, bakery, cheese and deli, butcher, frozen, liquor, cosmetics, drugstore and a pharmacy. Open seven days a week from 8 AM to 8 PM, holidays included.

name: Twenty4 Hostel
description: Paramaribo's first and only hostel, on Jessurunstraat, aimed at backpackers and independent travellers. It has private rooms and shared dorms with air conditioning or fans, a shared kitchen, garden, sun terrace and lounge, a 24-hour desk, shuttle service and bike hire. Adults only. The Central Market, the cathedral and the Waterkant are all close by.

name: Twins Pizza Burgers
description: Twins Pizza & Burgers is a fast-food spot in Paramaribo serving affordable pizzas and juicy burgers. Quick service and satisfying portions.

name: Typing Nomad N.V.
description: Typing Nomad N.V. is a remote-first, AI-driven software consultancy from Suriname that builds custom web and mobile applications and cloud solutions for clients worldwide.

name: U S Bakery
description: U.S. Bakery is a bakery in Paramaribo offering fresh bread, Surinamese pastries, savoury snacks and celebration cakes. A staple trusted by Paramaribo households.

name: Uitkijk Riverlounge Cafe
description: Uitkijk RiverLounge & Cafe is a riverside cafe and cocktail bar at Jarikabakreek 4 in Uitkijk, Saramacca, on the Saramacca River, serving food, drinks and music.

name: UNASAT
description: UNASAT (University of Applied Sciences and Technology Suriname) is a foundation set up in 2010 that offers higher professional (HBO) education programmes, with its main location at Hindilaan 1b in Paramaribo and a branch in Nickerie.

name: Uni Stone & More
description: Uni Stone & More is a building materials supplier in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering tiles, sanitary ware and design. Located at Commissaris Weythingweg 226a.

name: UniBiz Tech N.V.
description: UniBiz Tech N.V. (Unified Bizness Tech) is an ICT company at Walapastraat 27 in Paramaribo offering business automation, smart office tools, biometric systems, accounting software such as QuickBooks and Zoho, internet security, web services and digital marketing.

name: Unique Package Plan
description: Unique Package Plan is a travel agency at Margarethalaan 15 in Paramaribo, founded in 2012. It arranges travel packages within Suriname, the Guianas and abroad, along with airline tickets, cruises, group travel, car rental, airport transfers, private tours and travel insurance.

name: United Aviation Services NV
description: United Aviation Services NV is an aviation company offering helicopter transport services, based at Parastraat 136-140 in the Flora area of Paramaribo, Suriname, where the company operates a hangar for its aircraft.

name: United Caribbean Contractors (UCC)
description: United Caribbean Contractors (UCC) builds and maintains cable infrastructure for ICT and energy networks in Suriname, starting in 1995 with fibre-optic work. Its office is at Dr. Sophie Redmondstraat 252a, Paramaribo.

name: United slijterij
description: United Slijterij on the corner of Gemenelandsweg and Matawarilaan stocks beer, wine and spirits for parties and events.

name: Unlimited Suriname Tours
description: Unlimited Suriname Tours runs guided tours into Suriname's interior, covering rainforest, river and indigenous village experiences. Based in Paramaribo, the company handles logistics for multi-day jungle trips and day excursions for groups and individual travellers.

name: Unlock Nature
description: Unlock Nature is an eco tour operator based in Paramaribo offering jungle tours and wilderness expeditions in Suriname, led by wildlife guides and herpetologists. Trips range from single-day outings such as Peperpot and dolphin or turtle watching to multi-day tours, kayak and photography trips and river expeditions.

name: Unlocked Candles
description: Unlocked Candles is a Paramaribo-based artisan candle brand crafting premium scented candles. Each candle is handmade with care, making them popular gifts and home fragrance products.

name: Upgrade Business Support N.V.
description: Upgrade Business Support N.V. (UpBis) is a Paramaribo firm offering HRM solutions and business support services, including business optimisation, to organisations.

name: Urusji Lodge
description: A small family-run lodge at Galibi on the Marowijne estuary, with four rooms of up to three beds, shared bathrooms and self-catering. It sits close to the Galibi Nature Reserve, and the main draw is the green and leatherback turtle nesting season, alongside birdwatching, fishing and visits to the Kalina villages.

name: U.S. Polo Assn. Suriname
description: The U.S. Polo Assn. store in Paramaribo is in Ma Retraite Mall (units 67-68, Jan Steenstraat 118), selling the brand's polo shirts, casual wear and accessories for men and women. Contact +597 554-106.
address: Ma Retraite Mall units 67-68, Jan Steenstraat 118, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: UTEC Opleidingen
description: A vocational training provider in Suriname running courses and programmes aimed at the workplace, with most leading to a Dutch-recognised diploma or certificate.

name: Vabi N.V.
description: Vabi N.V. (Van Alen's Betonindustrie) is a concrete products manufacturer at Trefbalstraat #1 in Paramaribo, supplying concrete building materials, cement, garden decoration, rebar, steel profiles, tiles and tile adhesives.

name: Valcon•X
description: Valcon•X is a telematics company at Antondrachtenweg 68 in Paramaribo providing GPS tracking devices and solutions. Its services include vehicle and fleet tracking, fuel monitoring, connected dashcams, push to talk and asset tracking for sectors such as transport and logistics, construction, timber, oil and gas, and agriculture.

name: Van Brussel Design & Build N.V.
description: Van Brussel Design & Build N.V. is a design and build company in Wanica offering architectural design and construction. It is located at Welgedacht C No 461 B.
address: Welgedacht C No 461 B, Wanica, Suriname

name: Varossieau Suriname
description: Varossieau Suriname is a paint manufacturer that has been part of PPG Industries since 2007, producing paints and coatings in its own factory. Its main store is at Mastanaweg 4 in Paramaribo, and its products are sold through four Varossieau Decorating Centers and around 150 sub-dealers across Suriname.

name: Vasilda N.V.
description: Vasilda N.V. is a Paramaribo contractor handling architecture, construction, steel structures and renovation projects of any size. It is based at Arabistraat #1.

name: VCM Slagerij Brumastraat
description: VCM Slagerij Brumastraat is a butcher shop of the VCM chain at Mr. Eduard J. Brumastraat 4 in Paramaribo, selling fresh chicken, beef, pork and cold cuts, with a food corner for sandwiches. It is open Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 17:00 and Saturday until 14:00. VCM also has an online butcher at vcm.sr with delivery.
address: Mr. Eduard J. Brumastraat 4, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: VCM Slagerij Johannes Mungrastraat
description: VCM Slagerij Johannes Mungrastraat is a butcher shop of the VCM chain at Johannes Mungrastraat 21 in Paramaribo, selling fresh chicken, beef, pork and cold cuts. It has the longest opening hours of the VCM shops: Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and Saturday until 17:00.

name: VCM Slagerij Verlengde Gemenelandsweg
description: VCM Slagerij Verlengde Gemenelandsweg is a butcher shop of N.V. Verenigde Cultuur Maatschappijen at Verlengde Gemenelandsweg 134 in the Flora area of Paramaribo. It is a full-service butcher selling chicken, beef, pork and mutton, cold cuts, groceries, vegetables and fruit.

name: Vereniging Oase
description: Vereniging Oase is a sports club on Commewijnestraat in Paramaribo with five tennis courts, a swimming pool, football fields, a basketball court, a gym and a fitness trail.

name: Private Eco Resort Victorious
description: A private resort at Republiek in Para, on the bank of the Coropina creek and roughly ten minutes from Zanderij airport. The whole complex is hired as one: a house with four bedrooms, a large kitchen, hot and cold water and wifi throughout.

name: Vifa Trading
description: Vifa Trading is a building materials store at Franchepanestraat 136 in Paramaribo selling wall and floor tiles for indoor and outdoor use, as well as sanitary ware.

name: Vigy's Camp
description: A recreation spot on the Avobakaweg at Rama in Brokopondo, set up for day visits, swimming and barbecues in a forest setting.

name: Villa Famiri
description: Villa Famiri is a boutique hotel in Paramaribo with a warm, family atmosphere. Centrally located, it offers cosy rooms, a garden and personalised service. A favourite among independent travellers and repeat visitors to Suriname.

name: Villa Zapakara
description: Villa Zapakara is an interactive children's museum in Paramaribo where children and their parents learn about Surinamese culture, including Javanese Surinamese culture in its Kampong section.

name: Village Park 33
description: Village Park 33 is a private recreation spot in Cabendadorp, Para, rented out as a private venue for groups and families who want a day by the water. Bookings: +597 899-5293.

name: Villas Paramaribo
description: Villas Paramaribo offers a collection of self-catering villas and apartments for short and long-term stays in Suriname's capital. With full facilities and a residential feel, the property appeals to families and extended-stay business travellers.

name: Vincent Supermarket
description: Vincent Supermarket is a trusted neighbourhood supermarket in Suriname, providing fresh produce, groceries and everyday household items to the local community.

name: Vir Equipment NV
description: VIR Equipment N.V. sells equipment and spare parts in Paramaribo, with locations at Martin Luther Kingweg 52 and David Simonstraat 131 (Vir Equipment Noord).
address: Martin Luther Kingweg 52, David Simon St 131, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: VISAN CARS
description: VISAN CARS is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, repairs and maintenance. Located at Lalla Rookhweg #65.

name: Viva Mexico
description: Viva Mexico is a Mexican restaurant and bar in Paramaribo serving tacos, burritos, nachos and classic Mexican dishes alongside margaritas and Latin cocktails.

name: VJ Partners
description: VJ Partners is a professional services firm in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering accounting and tax advice. Located at Belladonna St 47.

name: Surinaamse Volkscredietbank
description: Surinaamse Volkscredietbank (VCB Bank) is a bank at Mr. F.H.R. Lim A Postraat 28-30 in central Paramaribo. It offers current and savings accounts, term deposits, personal loans, mortgages and car financing, microfinancing and investment credit for businesses, pawn credit, RIA money transfers and safe deposit boxes.
address: Mr. F.H.R. Lim A Po St 28-30, Centrum, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Vortex Aviation Academy
description: Vortex Aviation Academy is a flight school in Paramaribo that trains pilots, including PPL ground school courses, for local and regional demand.

name: Vreden English Language Training Consultancy
description: Vreden English Language Training & Consultancy (VELTC) provides English language training to individuals and offers consultancy, based on Stanvaste straat in central Paramaribo.

name: VRV Imports
description: VRV Imports is an automotive business in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering vehicle sales, shipping and customs clearance. Located at Voltastraat 23.

name: N.V. VSH TRADING - Red Wing
description: N.V. VSH Trading, established in 1978 at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 9-11 in Paramaribo, is the authorised Canon printer and copier distributor and Red Wing dealer, supplying safety footwear, workwear and personal protective equipment.
address: van ‘t Hogerhuysstraat 9-11 Paramaribo, Suriname, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: VSH Transport
description: VSH Transport is the Paramaribo port terminal operator of the VSH United group, active in cargo stevedoring and terminal cargo handling, with offices at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 9-11.

name: VSH United
description: VSH United (N.V. Verenigde Surinaamse Holdingmaatschappij) is a holding company headquartered at Van 't Hogerhuysstraat 9 in Paramaribo, with subsidiaries in trading, logistics, foods, real estate, services and investment, and detergents. Through associated companies it is also involved in insurance and hotels, and it operates in Suriname, Guyana, the United States and the Netherlands.

name: Waldos Worldwide Travel Service
description: Waldo's Worldwide Travel Service is a Paramaribo travel agency handling international flight bookings, hotel reservations, visa assistance and holiday packages. Suited to both leisure travellers and business clients needing end-to-end trip planning from Suriname.

name: Wan Bon Biri
description: Wan Bon Biri is a beer bar in Paramaribo, Suriname, pouring its own "Oso Biri" craft beers alongside imported beers, with a food menu to go with them. Located at Wilhelminastraat 19.

name: Wanica Technical Center
description: Wanica Technical Center is a store at Dr. H.C. van Ommerenstraat 16 in Paramaribo selling installation materials for electrical, water pipe, gas and sanitary work.
address: Dr. H.C van Ommerenstraat 16, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Warsha N.V.
description: Warsha N.V. is a wholesale and retail supplier of building materials and hardware at Kwattaweg 214 in Paramaribo. Its range includes doors and timber, electrical supplies, power tools and hand tools, locks, kitchen and sanitary fittings, garden supplies and agricultural implements.

name: Warung Blauwtjie
description: Warung Blauwtjie is a Javanese warung at Stolkweg 1 serving Javanese specialities for breakfast, brunch and lunch, with takeaway orders by phone on +597 856-4381. It has a large local following on Facebook.

name: Warung Mbah Paidjah
description: A Javanese warung on the Josephine Samson Greenstraat serving bami, nasi, telo, tahoe lontong, nasi rames and saoto. Cooking in the Javanese Surinamese tradition.

name: Warung Oetomo
description: A Javanese food stand at Verlengde Welgedacht C, serving traditional dishes to take away.

name: Warung Resa Centrum
description: Warung Resa Centrum is a traditional Javanese-Surinamese warung in central Paramaribo serving authentic Indonesian-influenced dishes. A cultural dining experience reflecting Suriname's Javanese heritage.

name: Warung Soepy Ann
description: Warung Soepy Ann is a traditional Surinamese eatery known for home-style cooking and beloved local dishes. A community favourite for affordable, authentic Surinamese food.

name: Waterland Suites
description: Waterland Suites is a small hotel in the Zorg en Hoop neighbourhood of Paramaribo offering two- and four-person rooms and self-contained residences. The property suits both short stays and longer visits, and caters to business travellers and tourists who prefer a quieter base outside the city centre.

name: Waterproof Tours Suriname
description: A tour operator best known for its Sunset & Dolphins boat trip on the Suriname River, a three-hour late-afternoon cruise that stops at a former plantation for a snack before turning back for the sunset. Waterproof also runs sea turtle trips and cultural tours to Moengo.

name: Wayfinders Exclusive N.V.
description: Wayfinders Exclusive is a car rental and ATV tour operator in Suriname, offering vehicle hire for independent travel alongside guided off-road ATV tours into Suriname's interior. A practical choice for travellers who want to explore beyond Paramaribo at their own pace.

name: Weblocher N.V.
description: Weblocher N.V. is a Paramaribo software company at Copernicusstraat 41 that builds custom applications and accounting software for small and medium-sized Surinamese businesses.

name: Welink Real Estate
description: Welink Real Estate is a real estate agency at Van Sommelsdijckstraat 1 in Paramaribo, with a second office in The Hague. It handles the sale, purchase and rental of residential and commercial property and offers valuations, expat services and drone photography.

name: WEngage Suriname
description: WEngage Suriname is the Paramaribo headquarters of WEngage, a business services company that works with clients to deliver customer experiences and customer contact services.

name: Wing Hung Cake Shop
description: Wing Hung is a long-running Chinese-Surinamese bakery selling cakes, pastries and traditional baked goods. Families across Paramaribo have been stopping by for generations.

name: Winkel ZARAH
description: Winkel ZARAH is a fashion retailer in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering clothing at its shop on Antondragtenweg 137. The store is located in the Morgenstond neighbourhood of Paramaribo Noord, in the north of the city.

name: Wolly's Zorg & Hoop
description: Wollys is a Surinamese fast-food chain with hot dogs, burgers and classic Surinamese fast food. A local brand with multiple locations across Paramaribo.

name: Wolly's Latourweg
description: Wolly's Latourweg is a branch of Wolly's, a Surinamese snack bar chain with an open kitchen serving fresh sandwiches, burgers, snacks, wraps and fries, located at Latourweg 59b in Paramaribo.

name: Wolly's Steenbakkerijstraat
description: Wolly's Steenbakkerijstraat is a branch of Wolly's, a Surinamese snack bar chain with an open kitchen serving fresh sandwiches, burgers, snacks, wraps and fries, located at Steenbakkerijstraat 41 in Paramaribo.

name: Woodwonders Suriname
description: Wood Wonders is a Surinamese wood products company producing handmade items from local tropical hardwoods: furniture, decorative pieces and custom woodwork. A family business with over 30 years in the trade, combining traditional craft with sustainably sourced Surinamese timber.

name: Wow Plus
description: WOW PLUS is a household goods store on Ringweg-Zuid in Paramaribo selling home and office furniture, clocks, decor, self-adhesive floor tiles and small appliances such as fans.

name: X Avenue
description: X-Avenue is a Surinamese restaurant in Paramaribo serving fresh, warm Surinamese dishes to eat in or take away, with locations on Ringweg Zuid and Jozef Israelstraat.

name: XINLI Glas & Aluminium
description: XINLI Glas & Aluminium is a Surinamese manufacturer at Indiraghandiweg 8 in Paramaribo specialising in aluminium and glass building work, such as sliding windows, doors and other metalwork.

name: XINLI Wood Processing
description: XINLI Wood Processing, part of XINLI, is a wood workshop and furniture store at Oost-West Verbinding 132 in Meerzorg, Commewijne, making solid wood furniture, kitchen cabinets and timber products such as cladding boards.

name: Yasmin Luxury Resort
description: A family-oriented resort on Verlengde Jacques Gompertstraat in Paramaribo. Rooms are air conditioned with kitchenettes, balconies, private bathrooms and free wifi. Facilities include an indoor pool, hot tub, fitness room, sun terrace, garden and outdoor play area, and the restaurant serves a halal breakfast alongside brunch, lunch and dinner.
address: Julius Anton de Komstraat 89, Surivillage 4, Paramaribo, Suriname

name: Ying Hao Beautyshop
description: Ying Hao Beautyshop is a beauty and cosmetics shop at Kernkampweg 15 in central Paramaribo, Suriname. It carries a range of cosmetics, hair-care products and beauty accessories for everyday personal care.

name: Yoga Peetha Happiness Centre
description: Yoga Peetha Happiness Centre is a yoga studio at Picassostraat 113 in Paramaribo offering yoga and activities aimed at health and happiness, including wellness talks and vegetarian lunches.

name: Yogh Hospitality
description: Yogh Hospitality is a luxury hotel at Domineestraat 7-11 in central Paramaribo with a restaurant, spa and rooftop pool, which also hosts business lunches and corporate events.

name: Yokohama Trading
description: Yokohama Trading N.V. is a car dealership in Paramaribo with over 25 years of experience, selling new and used vehicles, and is the official Great Wall Motors, SANY and JMC dealer in Suriname.

name: Young Engineers
description: Young Engineers is an educational programme in Suriname teaching STEM and engineering principles to children through fun, hands-on activities with building toys and technology.

name: Zeedijk Resort Nickerie
description: A guesthouse on Van Idsingaweg in Nieuw Nickerie, roughly 2 km from the town centre and facing the sea dike. Rooms are air-conditioned with kitchenettes and private bathrooms, and the property has a garden, terraces with sea views, free parking and bicycles for guests.

name: Zeelandia Suites
description: Zeelandia Suites is a hotel in Paramaribo established in March 1997, located near the city's commercial centre. Accommodation is in self-contained suites with a bedroom, living room, bathroom and balcony or terrace. Restaurants, cafes, museums and other city amenities are within walking distance.

name: Zeepfabriek JOAB
description: Zeepfabriek Joab is a Surinamese family-owned soap manufacturer with over 30 years of experience producing natural, handmade eco-friendly soaps. Products are made from local ingredients and sold both locally and to the export market.

name: Zeg Ijsje
description: Zeg IJsje is an ice cream and dessert shop in Paramaribo serving fresh tropical flavours and classic scoops. A sweet stop for families across the city.

name: Zenobia Bottling Company
description: Zenobia Bottling Company N.V. is an ISO 22000 certified Surinamese company in Uitkijk that bottles purified drinking water in gallon containers and also sells water purifiers.

name: Zin Resort
description: A public swimming pool, guesthouse and bar on Van Roseveltkade in Paramaribo, about 3 km from the centre. The pool is open to day visitors.

name: Zinnia Taxi
description: Zinnia Taxi is a travel and transport company in Paramaribo, Suriname, offering airport transfers. Located at Zinnia St 49.

name: Zus & Zo Cafe
description: Zus & Zo is a cafe in Paramaribo serving Caribbean and international fusion cuisine, with vegetarian and vegan options on the menu. Open daily, it draws a consistent mix of locals and visitors. Known for a friendly atmosphere and a varied menu that goes beyond standard cafe fare.

name: Zwembad Energy
